title: Everyday Phrases — At a Night Market
title_quote: Which corner should we meet at?
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🏮 實用「逛夜市」必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡800句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 800 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — At a Night Market
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用「逛夜市」情境對話，共 800 句、400 組短句（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫）。從約在哪個路口碰面、排隊點烤串、問辣不辣，到找一張長桌跟陌生人共用、算一共多少錢、發現現金不夠，最後買一份甜甜圈、提著袋子回旅館，八個場景一路聽下去。每句 3 到 9 個字，A2 生活口語，不用背、不用看螢幕，躺下來循環聽 800 句就能記住。適合英語初學者、ESL 學員、想睡前複習英文的大人。#英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features 800 practical At a Night Market phrases in 400 pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). Eight scenes run in order: agreeing on which corner to meet, lining up to order skewers, asking how spicy it is, sharing one long table with strangers, counting the whole bill, finding out your cash is not enough, buying one box of doughnuts, and carrying the bags back to the hotel. Every line is 3 to 9 words at CEFR A2 level, so you just lie down and let the 800-sentence loop do the work. Great for beginners, ESL learners, and anyone reviewing English before bed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which corner should we meet at?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ ˈkɔrnər ʃʊd wi mit æt?/
dialogue.zh: 我們約在哪個路口轉角碰面？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The northeast corner, by the red lanterns.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˌnɔrθˈist ˈkɔrnər, baɪ ðə rɛd ˈlæntərnz./
dialogue.zh: 東北角，掛紅燈籠的那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you find the night market gate yet?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju faɪnd ðə naɪt ˈmɑrkɪt ɡeɪt jɛt?/
dialogue.zh: 你找到夜市入口了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, the crowd starts right at the crosswalk.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt jɛt, ðə kraʊd stɑrts raɪt æt ðə ˈkrɔswɔk./
dialogue.zh: 還沒，人潮剛好從斑馬線那裡開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look for the stall with the yellow awning.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk fɔr ðə stɔl wɪð ðə ˈjɛloʊ ˈɔnɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 找那個有黃色雨棚的攤位。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The awning is over the skewer cart, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈɔnɪŋ ɪz ˈoʊvər ðə ˈskjʊr kɑrt, raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 雨棚蓋在烤串推車上面，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am standing under the big menu board.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm ˈstændɪŋ ˈʌndər ðə bɪɡ ˈmɛnju bɔrd./
dialogue.zh: 我站在大菜單看板下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Walk past that board and turn toward the smoke.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔk pæst ðæt bɔrd ænd tɜrn təˈwɔrd ðə smoʊk./
dialogue.zh: 走過看板，再朝有煙的地方轉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you hear me over the generator noise?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju hɪr mi ˈoʊvər ðə ˈdʒɛnəreɪtər nɔɪz?/
dialogue.zh: 發電機那麼吵，你聽得到我嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Barely, come out to the front of the stall.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɛrli, kʌm aʊt tə ðə frʌnt əv ðə stɔl./
dialogue.zh: 有點難，你走到攤位前面來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone almost died by the subway exit.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ foʊn ˈɔlmoʊst daɪd baɪ ðə ˈsʌbwe ˈɛɡzɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我的手機在地鐵出口那邊快沒電了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Charge it later, our skewer ticket comes soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɑrdʒ ɪt ˈleɪtər, ˈaʊər ˈskjʊr ˈtɪkɪt kʌmz sun./
dialogue.zh: 待會兒再充，我們烤串的號碼快叫到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which subway exit did you take, one or two?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ ˈsʌbwe ˈɛɡzɪt dɪd ju teɪk, wʌn ɔr tu?/
dialogue.zh: 你走哪個地鐵出口，一號還是二號？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exit two, it opens beside the tea egg cart.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛɡzɪt tu, ɪt ˈoʊpənz bəˈsaɪd ðə ti ɛɡ kɑrt./
dialogue.zh: 二號出口，一出來就在茶葉蛋車旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait by the trash bin, not in the doorway.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt baɪ ðə træʃ bɪn, nɑt ɪn ðə ˈdɔrˌweɪ./
dialogue.zh: 在垃圾桶邊等，別站在門口。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fine, but the smell there really is strong.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪn, bʌt ðə smɛl ðɛr ˈrɪli ɪz strɔŋ./
dialogue.zh: 好，不過那兒的味道真的很重。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I see your green jacket above the crowd.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ si jʊr ɡrin ˈdʒækɪt əˈbʌv ðə kraʊd./
dialogue.zh: 我在人潮上方看到你的綠外套。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wave here, then follow the sound of the grill.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪv hɪr, ðɛn ˈfɑloʊ ðə saʊnd əv ðə ɡrɪl./
dialogue.zh: 在這裡揮手，然後跟著烤爐的聲音走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I come through the row or the street?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ kʌm θru ðə roʊ ɔr ðə strit?/
dialogue.zh: 我該從美食那一排走，還是走馬路？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the row, the street is jammed with scooters.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ðə roʊ, ðə strit ɪz dʒæmd wɪð ˈskutərz./
dialogue.zh: 走那一排，馬路上擠滿機車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did we say north corner or south corner?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd wi seɪ nɔrθ ˈkɔrnər ɔr saʊθ ˈkɔrnər?/
dialogue.zh: 我們講的是北角還是南角？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: North one, where the lantern string starts.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɔrθ wʌn, wɛr ðə ˈlæntərn strɪŋ stɑrts./
dialogue.zh: 北邊那個，燈籠串從那裡開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I got here early, the stalls just opened.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ɡɑt hɪr ˈɜrli, ðə stɔlz dʒʌst ˈoʊpənd./
dialogue.zh: 我早到了，攤位才剛開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, the skewer line grows long by eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt, ðə ˈskjʊr laɪn ɡroʊz lɔŋ baɪ eɪt./
dialogue.zh: 剛好，八點一到烤串隊就變長。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Meet me where the intersection bends near the temple.
dialogue.phonetic: /mit mi wɛr ðə ˌɪntərˈsɛkʃən bɛndz nɪr ðə ˈtɛmpəl./
dialogue.zh: 在路口靠近廟那個彎等我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That bend holds the strongest grill smoke here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt bɛnd hoʊldz ðə ˈstrɔŋəst ɡrɪl smoʊk hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 那個彎頭的烤煙是這一帶最濃的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you count the stalls from the corner?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju kaʊnt ðə stɔlz frʌm ðə ˈkɔrnər?/
dialogue.zh: 你從路口數得出來有幾攤嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fourth one after the betel nut stand.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔrθ wʌn ˈæftər ðə ˈbitəl nʌt stænd./
dialogue.zh: 檳榔攤之後的第四攤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am holding two napkins and a wet wipe.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm ˈhoʊldɪŋ tu ˈnæpkɪnz ænd ə wɛt waɪp./
dialogue.zh: 我手上拿著兩張紙巾和一包濕紙巾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Grab more, the sauce runs down your wrist.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡræb mɔr, ðə sɔs rʌnz daʊn jʊr rɪst./
dialogue.zh: 多拿幾張，醬會順著手腕流下去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you remember the stall name I texted you?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju rɪˈmɛmbər ðə stɔl neɪm aɪ ˈtɛkst ju?/
dialogue.zh: 還記得我傳給你的攤名嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the one with the big skewer menu board.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðə wʌn wɪð ðə bɪɡ ˈskjʊr ˈmɛnju bɔrd./
dialogue.zh: 記得，掛大烤串菜單板的那一攤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn left after the bubble tea cart.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn lɛft ˈæftər ðə ˈbʌbəl ti kɑrt./
dialogue.zh: 過了珍珠奶茶車就往左。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Left, then stop at the second light pole.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛft, ðɛn stɑp æt ðə ˈsɛkənd laɪt poʊl./
dialogue.zh: 往左，然後在第二根燈柱停下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long have you waited at this corner?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ hæv ju ˈweɪtɪd æt ðɪs ˈkɔrnər?/
dialogue.zh: 你在這個路口等了多久了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten minutes, and the smell made me hungrier.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ˈmɪnɪts, ænd ðə smɛl meɪd mi ˈhʌŋɡriər./
dialogue.zh: 十分鐘，而且那個味道讓我更餓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The stall speaker keeps calling order numbers.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə stɔl ˈspikər kips ˈkɔlɪŋ ˈɔrdər ˈnʌmbərz./
dialogue.zh: 攤子的小喇叭一直叫號碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then watch the ticket in your hand closely.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wɑtʃ ðə ˈtɪkɪt ɪn jʊr hænd ˈkloʊsli./
dialogue.zh: 那就把號碼牌拿在手上盯緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Am I late, or did the market shift tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /æm aɪ leɪt, ɔr dɪd ðə ˈmɑrkɪt ʃɪft təˈnaɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 是我遲了，還是夜市今晚換了位置？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It moved one block, the sign still shows here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt muvd wʌn blɑk, ðə saɪn stɪl ʃoʊz hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 往前提了一條街，牌子還插在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which side of the road is the meat grill?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ saɪd əv ðə roʊd ɪz ðə mit ɡrɪl?/
dialogue.zh: 烤肉架在馬路的哪一邊？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same side, just past the shaved ice stand.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm saɪd, dʒʌst pæst ðə ʃeɪvd aɪs stænd./
dialogue.zh: 同一邊，經過刨冰攤就是。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I passed three stalls selling only corn.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ pæst θri stɔlz ˈsɛlɪŋ ˈoʊnli kɔrn./
dialogue.zh: 我路過三攤只賣玉米的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Skip corn, we came here for the skewers.
dialogue.phonetic: /skɪp kɔrn, wi keɪm hɪr fɔr ðə ˈskjʊrz./
dialogue.zh: 玉米先放著，我們是為串來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Save me a spot by the plastic stools.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪv mi ə spɑt baɪ ðə ˈplæstɪk stulz./
dialogue.zh: 在塑膠椅那邊幫我留個位置。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stools fill fast, they are gone by eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /stulz fɪl fæst, ðeɪ ər ɡɑn baɪ eɪt./
dialogue.zh: 塑膠椅一下就坐滿，八點就沒位置了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the lantern string change since last month?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ðə ˈlæntərn strɪŋ tʃeɪndʒ sɪns læst mʌnθ?/
dialogue.zh: 燈籠串這個月跟上月換位了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same string, only more bulbs burnt out.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm strɪŋ, ˈoʊnli mɔr bʌlbz bɜrnt aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 還是那串，只是燒掉的燈泡變多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I hear scooters passing way too close here.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hɪr ˈskutərz ˈpæsɪŋ weɪ tu kloʊs hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 我聽到機車從這邊擦得好近。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Step behind the cone, it marks the waiting zone.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɛp bɪˈhaɪnd ðə koʊn, ɪt mɑrks ðə ˈweɪtɪŋ zoʊn./
dialogue.zh: 站到三角錐後面，那是等位區。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Follow the crowd and you will find smoke.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɑloʊ ðə kraʊd ænd ju wɪl faɪnd smoʊk./
dialogue.zh: 跟著人潮走你就會看到煙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smoke means the grill, and the grill means us.
dialogue.phonetic: /smoʊk minz ðə ɡrɪl, ænd ðə ɡrɪl minz ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 有煙就有烤架，有烤架就輪到我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Text me when the corner looks less packed.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛkst mi wɛn ðə ˈkɔrnər lʊks lɛs pækt./
dialogue.zh: 路口比較空的時候傳訊息給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No signal here, the tents block everything.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈsɪɡnəl hɪr, ðə tɛnts blɑk ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 這裡沒訊號，帳棚全擋住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that man waving or just stretching his arm?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt mæn ˈweɪvɪŋ ɔr dʒʌst ˈstrɛtʃɪŋ hɪz ɑrm?/
dialogue.zh: 那個人是在揮手，還只是在伸手臂？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Waving, so hurry before he loses patience.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈweɪvɪŋ, soʊ ˈhɜri bɪˈfɔr hi ˈluːzəz ˈpeɪʃəns./
dialogue.zh: 在揮手，所以快點，別等他沒耐心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We agreed on eight, and it is eight ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi əˈɡrid ɑn eɪt, ænd ɪt ɪz eɪt tɛn./
dialogue.zh: 我們約八點，現在已經八點十了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Late penalty, you buy the first two skewers.
dialogue.phonetic: /leɪt ˈpɛnəlti, ju baɪ ðə fɜrst tu ˈskjʊrz./
dialogue.zh: 遲到罰則，前兩串你請客。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you see the awning from where you stand?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju si ðə ˈɔnɪŋ frʌm wɛr ju stænd?/
dialogue.zh: 你站的地方看得到那個雨棚嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only the edge, the rest hides behind people.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ði ɛdʒ, ðə rɛst haɪdz bɪˈhaɪnd ˈpipəl./
dialogue.zh: 只看到邊，其餘被人擋住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Walk toward the drum sound, not the lights.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔk təˈwɔrd ðə drʌm saʊnd, nɑt ðə laɪts./
dialogue.zh: 朝敲鼓的聲音走，別朝燈光。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That drum means the peanut candy cart.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt drʌm minz ðə ˈpitˌnʌt ˈkændi kɑrt./
dialogue.zh: 那鼓聲是賣花生糖的推車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold my bag, I will push through first.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld maɪ bæɡ, aɪ wɪl pʊʃ θru fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 先幫我拿袋子，我擠過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Push slow, the floor is greasy near the fryer.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊʃ sloʊ, ðə flɔr ɪz ˈɡrisi nɪr ðə ˈfraɪər./
dialogue.zh: 慢慢擠，油鍋旁邊地面很滑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the flower lady move her cart again?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ðə ˈflaʊɚ ˈleɪdi muv hɜr kɑrt əˈɡɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 賣花的姊姊又把推車移走啦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She sits by the crosswalk now, past us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi sɪts baɪ ðə ˈkrɔswɔk naʊ, pæst ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 她現在坐在斑馬線邊，在我們前面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I count six people ahead at this corner.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kaʊnt sɪks ˈpipəl əˈhɛd æt ðɪs ˈkɔrnər./
dialogue.zh: 我數到這路口前面有六個人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six is fine, the owner works two grills.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ɪz faɪn, ði ˈoʊnər wɜrks tu ɡrɪlz./
dialogue.zh: 六個還好，老闆同時顧兩爐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wave again, my glasses fogged from the steam.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪv əˈɡɛn, maɪ ˈɡlæsɪz fɔɡd frʌm ðə stim./
dialogue.zh: 再揮一次，眼鏡被蒸汽霧化了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Steam means soup, that stall sells oyster noodles.
dialogue.phonetic: /stim minz sup, ðæt stɔl sɛlz ˈɔɪstər ˈnudəlz./
dialogue.zh: 有蒸汽就是有湯，那攤賣蚵仔麵線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Meet me where the two streets cut across.
dialogue.phonetic: /mit mi wɛr ðə tu strits kʌt əˈkrɔs./
dialogue.zh: 在兩條街交叉的地方等我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That cut is blocked by a parked delivery truck.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt kʌt ɪz blɑkt baɪ ə pɑrkt dɪˈlɪvɚi trʌk./
dialogue.zh: 那個路口被一台停著的送貨卡車擋住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you smell charcoal or only sweet sauce?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju smɛl ˈtʃɑrˌkoʊl ɔr ˈoʊnli swit sɔs?/
dialogue.zh: 你聞到木炭味了嗎，還是只有甜醬？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both, plus cumin on something grilling hard.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ, plʌs ˈkjuˌmɪn ɑn ˈsʌmθɪŋ ˈɡrɪlɪŋ hɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 兩種都有，還有孜然在猛火上烤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The corner lamp is out, watch your feet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkɔrnər læmp ɪz aʊt, wɑtʃ jʊr fit./
dialogue.zh: 路口的燈壞了，看腳下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good thing we know this intersection by heart.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd θɪŋ wi noʊ ðɪs ˌɪntərˈsɛkʃən baɪ hɑrt./
dialogue.zh: 好在我們把這個路口記熟了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any stall with a line is the good one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni stɔl wɪð ə laɪn ɪz ðə ɡʊd wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 有排隊的攤位就是好攤。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This line doubled since I crossed the street.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs laɪn ˈdəbəld sɪns aɪ krɔst ðə strit./
dialogue.zh: 我過個街的工夫，隊伍就加倍了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Say the stall color again, the light is bad.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪ ðə stɔl ˈkʌlər əˈɡɛn, ðə laɪt ɪz bæd./
dialogue.zh: 再說一次那攤的顏色，燈太暗了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blue tarp, yellow bulbs, red skewer boxes.
dialogue.phonetic: /blu tɑrp, ˈjɛloʊ bʌlbz, rɛd ˈskjʊr ˈbɑksɪz./
dialogue.zh: 藍防水布、黃燈泡、紅色烤串箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am under the blue tarp now, come over.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm ˈʌndər ðə blu tɑrp naʊ, kʌm ˈoʊvər./
dialogue.zh: 我現在在藍防水布底下，過來吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Coming, with only my phone and an empty stomach.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkʌmɪŋ, wɪð ˈoʊnli maɪ foʊn ænd æn ˈɛmpti ˈstʌmək./
dialogue.zh: 來了，只帶著手機和一個空胃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you bring the list I sent last night?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju brɪŋ ðə lɪst aɪ sɛnt læst naɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 你有帶我昨晚傳的那張清單嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It sits on my screen, ten sticks each.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt sɪts ɑn maɪ skrin, tɛn stɪks itʃ./
dialogue.zh: 就在螢幕上，一人十串。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold the ticket, I will get the drinks first.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ðə ˈtɪkɪt, aɪ wɪl ɡɛt ðə drɪŋks fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 你拿著號碼牌，我先去端兩杯飲料。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One tea, one plum juice, by the cash box.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ti, wʌn plʌm dʒus, baɪ ðə kæʃ bɑks./
dialogue.zh: 一杯茶、一杯冬瓜茶，就在錢箱旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where exactly should we stand while we wait?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɪɡˈzæktli ʃʊd wi stænd waɪl wi weɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 等待的時候我們到底該站在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Under the awning edge, clear of the walkway.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʌndər ði ˈɔnɪŋ ɛdʒ, klɪr əv ðə ˈwɔkweɪ./
dialogue.zh: 雨棚邊就好，避開走路的人道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This intersection feels louder than it looked online.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˌɪntərˈsɛkʃən filz ˈlaʊdər ðæn ɪt lʊkt ˈɑnˌlaɪn./
dialogue.zh: 這個路口比網路上看起來吵多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Online photos never carry the crowd noise.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɑnˌlaɪn ˈfoʊtoʊz ˈnɛvər ˈkæri ðə kraʊd nɔɪz./
dialogue.zh: 網路照片從來不會有那些人聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tell me you are not lost again tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl mi ju ɑr nɑt lɔst əˈɡɛn təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 告訴我你今晚沒有又迷路。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not lost, just stuck behind a bamboo steamer cart.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt lɔst, dʒʌst stʌk bɪˈhaɪnd ə ˌbæmˈbu ˈstimər kɑrt./
dialogue.zh: 沒迷路，只是被一台竹蒸籠車卡住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you spot the man holding a fan?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju spɑt ðə mæn ˈhoʊldɪŋ ə fæn?/
dialogue.zh: 你看到那個拿扇子的男人了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fan man is our stall, and he waves back.
dialogue.phonetic: /fæn mæn ɪz ˈaʊər stɔl, ænd hi weɪvz bæk./
dialogue.zh: 拿扇子的就是我們那攤，他揮手回應。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Move your bag, a scooter wants this lane.
dialogue.phonetic: /muv jʊr bæɡ, ə ˈskutər wɑnts ðɪs leɪn./
dialogue.zh: 把袋子挪一下，機車要用這條道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bag stays on my shoulder, keep walking forward.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæɡ steɪz ɑn maɪ ˈʃoʊldər, kip ˈwɔkɪŋ ˈfɔrwərd./
dialogue.zh: 袋子掛我肩上，我們繼續往前。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Almost there, I see the red skewer boxes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlmoʊst ðɛr, aɪ si ðə rɛd ˈskjʊr ˈbɑksɪz./
dialogue.zh: 快到了，我看到紅色烤串箱了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Finally, my feet hurt from that whole block.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfaɪnəli, maɪ fit hɜrt frʌm ðæt hoʊl blɑk./
dialogue.zh: 天啊，走完整條街我的腳都在痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, we met at the corner we planned.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, wi mɛt æt ðə ˈkɔrnər wi plænd./
dialogue.zh: 真好，我們就在約定的路口見面了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly that, now let us get in line.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ðæt, naʊ lɛt ʌs ɡɛt ɪn laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 就是那裡，現在我們去排隊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many skewers did you count for us?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni ˈskjʊrz dɪd ju kaʊnt fɔr ʌs?/
dialogue.zh: 你幫我們數到要點幾串？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty sticks, half of them are lamb.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti stɪks, hæf ɑv ðɛm ər læm./
dialogue.zh: 二十串，其中一半是羊肉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this the line for the charcoal skewers?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɪs ðə laɪn fɔr ðə ˈtʃɑrˌkoʊl ˈskjʊrz?/
dialogue.zh: 這一排是等炭烤串的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, stand behind me and do not leave.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, stænd bɪˈhaɪnd mi ænd du nɑt liv./
dialogue.zh: 對，站我後面別走開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Move up, the queue shortened by two people.
dialogue.phonetic: /muv ʌp, ðə kju ˈʃɔrtənd baɪ tu ˈpipəl./
dialogue.zh: 往前挪，隊伍少了兩個人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slow, my shoes slipped on a skewer stick.
dialogue.phonetic: /sloʊ, maɪ ʃuz slɪpt ɑn ə ˈskjʊr stɪk./
dialogue.zh: 慢點，我踩到竹簽滑了一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The grill man has not looked up once.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɡrɪl mæn hæz nɑt lʊkt ʌp wʌns./
dialogue.zh: 烤架那個人一次都沒抬頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He flips forty sticks with one hand, watch.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi flɪps ˈfɔrti stɪks wɪð wʌn hænd, wɑtʃ./
dialogue.zh: 他一隻手翻四十串，你看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Order when he calls our number, not before.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔrdər wɛn hi kɔlz ˈaʊər ˈnʌmbər, nɑt bɪˈfɔr./
dialogue.zh: 等他叫號再點，別搶先。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our ticket says B nine, not B ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər ˈtɪkɪt sɛz bi naɪn, nɑt bi tɛn./
dialogue.zh: 我們那張牌是九號，不是十號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, he wrote lamb and chicken on the board.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk, hi roʊt læm ænd ˈtʃɪkən ɑn ðə bɔrd./
dialogue.zh: 你看，他板上寫了羊肉和雞肉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Chicken takes longer, the meat is thicker.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtʃɪkən teɪks ˈlɔŋɡər, ðə mit ɪz ˈθɪkər./
dialogue.zh: 雞肉烤得久一點，肉塊比較厚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ask him for two wings and one chicken neck.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk hɪm fɔr tu wɪŋz ænd wʌn ˈtʃɪkən nɛk./
dialogue.zh: 跟他要兩隻雞翅和一個雞頸。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Neck is hard to eat, let us skip it.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛk ɪz hɑrd tə it, lɛt ʌs skɪp ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 雞頸不好吃，我們不要了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which stick smells like the chili oil?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ stɪk smɛlz laɪk ðə ˈtʃɪli ɔɪl?/
dialogue.zh: 哪一串聞起來有辣椒油的味道？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The shiny ones, they sit near the fan.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈʃaɪni wʌnz, ðeɪ sɪt nɪr ðə fæn./
dialogue.zh: 油亮那些，擺在風扇旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stand out of the smoke, you are coughing.
dialogue.phonetic: /stænd aʊt əv ðə smoʊk, ju ɑr ˈkɔfɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 站到煙外面，你都在咳嗽了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Coughing or not, I want the first batch.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɔfɪŋ ɔr nɑt, aɪ wɑnt ðə fɜrst bætʃ./
dialogue.zh: 不管咳不咳，第一爐我要。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The batch takes six minutes on this grill.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bætʃ teɪks sɪks ˈmɪnɪts ɑn ðɪs ɡrɪl./
dialogue.zh: 這一爐要烤六分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six minutes, so let us watch the sauce pot.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ˈmɪnɪts, soʊ lɛt ʌs wɑtʃ ðə sɔs pɑt./
dialogue.zh: 六分鐘，那我們盯著醬料鍋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you want cheese on the corn skewer?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju wɑnt tʃiz ɑn ðə kɔrn ˈskjʊr?/
dialogue.zh: 玉米串要加起司嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, extra cheese and no green onion.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ˈɛkstrə tʃiz ænd noʊ ɡrin ˈʌnjən./
dialogue.zh: 要，起司多放，不要蔥。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tell him now, he stops writing at nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl hɪm naʊ, hi stɑps ˈraɪtɪŋ æt naɪn./
dialogue.zh: 現在就跟他說，九點他就不寫單了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine already, the market closes at eleven.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn ɔlˈrɛdi, ðə ˈmɑrkɪt ˈkloʊzɪz æt ɪˈlɛvən./
dialogue.zh: 已經九點了，夜市十一點收。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He wrote our sticks on a scrap of paper.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi roʊt ˈaʊər stɪks ɑn ə skræp əv ˈpeɪpər./
dialogue.zh: 他把我們的串寫在一張碎紙上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Paper is good, keep it till the end.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpeɪpər ɪz ɡʊd, kip ɪt tɪl ði ɛnd./
dialogue.zh: 紙單正好，留到最後再對。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is that woman holding two tickets?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ ɪz ðæt ˈwʊmən ˈhoʊldɪŋ tu ˈtɪkɪts?/
dialogue.zh: 為什麼那個姊姊拿著兩張號碼牌？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She buys for her whole family, eleven sticks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi baɪz fɔr hɜr hoʊl ˈfæməli, ɪˈlɛvən stɪks./
dialogue.zh: 她幫一家人點，十一串。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Count again, I think he missed three lamb.
dialogue.phonetic: /kaʊnt əˈɡɛn, aɪ θɪŋk hi mɪst θri læm./
dialogue.zh: 再數一次，我覺得他漏了三串羊肉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three missed, I will flag them on the ticket.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri mɪst, aɪ wɪl flæɡ ðɛm ɑn ðə ˈtɪkɪt./
dialogue.zh: 漏了三串，我要在號碼牌上標一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Flag it nicely, the man works without rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /flæɡ ɪt ˈnaɪsli, ðə mæn wɜrks wɪˈðaʊt rɛst./
dialogue.zh: 說的時候客氣點，他整晚沒停過。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: True, his apron is soaked through already.
dialogue.phonetic: /tru, hɪz ˈeɪprən ɪz soʊkt θru ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 也是，他的圍裙早就濕透了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which sauce did you say he brushes last?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ sɔs dɪd ju seɪ hi brʌʃz læst?/
dialogue.zh: 你說他最後刷的是哪種醬？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The sweet one, right before it comes off.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə swit wʌn, raɪt bɪˈfɔr ɪt kʌmz ɔf./
dialogue.zh: 甜的那種，出爐前才刷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not blink, the burnt ones taste better.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt blɪŋk, ðə bɜrnt wʌnz teɪst ˈbɛtər./
dialogue.zh: 別眨眼，烤焦一點的比較香。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then order two extra burnt sticks for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ˈɔrdər tu ˈɛkstrə bɜrnt stɪks fɔr mi./
dialogue.zh: 那就替我多點兩串烤焦的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long is this line past ten at night?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ ɪz ðɪs laɪn pæst tɛn æt naɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 過了十點，這一排還要等多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One hour at least, and it grows later.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈaʊər æt list, ænd ɪt ɡroʊz ˈleɪtər./
dialogue.zh: 至少一小時，而且越晚越久。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Say the order out loud, my ear is bad.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪ ði ˈɔrdər aʊt laʊd, maɪ ɪr ɪz bæd./
dialogue.zh: 把點的內容大聲念一遍，我耳朵不靈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lamb ten, beef five, corn three, wings two.
dialogue.phonetic: /læm tɛn, bif faɪv, kɔrn θri, wɪŋz tu./
dialogue.zh: 羊肉十、牛肉五、玉米三、雞翅二。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty sticks in all, that is a big table.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti stɪks ɪn ɔl, ðæt ɪz ə bɪɡ ˈteɪbəl./
dialogue.zh: 總共二十串，這一桌吃很多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Big or not, we finish them in minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪɡ ɔr nɑt, wi ˈfɪnɪʃ ðɛm ɪn ˈmɪnɪts./
dialogue.zh: 不管多不多，幾分鐘就見底。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Watch the man behind us, he keeps reaching.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑtʃ ðə mæn bɪˈhaɪnd ʌs, hi kips ˈritʃɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 看我們後面那個人，他一直在伸手。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He wants a ticket too, two are left.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi wɑnts ə ˈtɪkɪt tu, tu ɑr lɛft./
dialogue.zh: 他也想拿號碼牌，只剩兩張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let him take one, we hold ours already.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt hɪm teɪk wʌn, wi hoʊld ˈaʊərz ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 讓他拿一張吧，我們自己有號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, he says thanks with a big wide smile.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn, hi sɛz θæŋks wɪð ə bɪɡ waɪd smaɪl./
dialogue.zh: 給他了，他笑著跟我們道謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The grill man calls our number, B nine!
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɡrɪl mæn kɔlz ˈaʊər ˈnʌmbər, bi naɪn!/
dialogue.zh: 烤架那個人喊我們的號，九號！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is us, grab the tongs and go.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ʌs, ɡræb ðə tɔŋz ænd ɡoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 是我們，拿夾子過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do we put the sticks after eating?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du wi pʊt ðə stɪks ˈæftər ˈitɪŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 吃完的竹簽要擱在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In the metal bucket, beside the big table.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ðə ˈmɛtəl ˈbʌkɪt, bəˈsaɪd ðə bɪɡ ˈteɪbəl./
dialogue.zh: 丟進鐵桶，就在大桌旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Smell this one, the cumin is strong tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɛl ðɪs wʌn, ðə ˈkjuˌmɪn ɪz strɔŋ təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 聞這串，今晚孜然特別重。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Strong is good, that is why we queue here.
dialogue.phonetic: /strɔŋ ɪz ɡʊd, ðæt ɪz waɪ wi kju hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 重才好，這就是我們來排隊的理由。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your lamb came with extra fat on top.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr læm keɪm wɪð ˈɛkstrə fæt ɑn tɑp./
dialogue.zh: 你的羊肉上面多了一塊肥的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fat is the best part, do not touch it.
dialogue.phonetic: /fæt ɪz ðə bɛst pɑrt, du nɑt tʌtʃ ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 肥肉才是最好吃的部分，別碰。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two sticks fell onto the paper sheet.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu stɪks fɛl ˈɑntu ðə ˈpeɪpər ʃit./
dialogue.zh: 有兩串掉到墊紙上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clean side down, one blow and it is fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /klin saɪd daʊn, wʌn bloʊ ænd ɪt ɪz faɪn./
dialogue.zh: 乾淨那面朝下，吹一下就沒事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Give me one beef, mine went too fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɪv mi wʌn bif, maɪn wɛnt tu fæst./
dialogue.zh: 給我一串牛肉，我的一下子就吃完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yours always vanish, take two from here.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊrz ˈɔlˌweɪz ˈvænɪʃ, teɪk tu frʌm hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 你的總會消失，從這裡拿兩串吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How does he keep so many sticks even?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ dʌz hi kip soʊ ˈmɛni stɪks ˈivən?/
dialogue.zh: 他怎麼把這麼多串烤得一樣熟？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Even? Half are burnt on one side only.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈivən? hæf ɑr bɜrnt ɑn wʌn saɪd ˈoʊnli./
dialogue.zh: 一樣熟？有一半只焦了一面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ask him what he puts on the pork skin.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk hɪm wʌt hi pʊts ɑn ðə pɔrk skɪn./
dialogue.zh: 問問他豬皮上面撒的是什麼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pork skin needs five minutes, not one.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɔrk skɪn nidz faɪv ˈmɪnɪts, nɑt wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 豬皮要烤五分鐘，不是隨便一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, we never ordered the bitter melon.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt, wi ˈnɛvər ˈɔrdərd ðə ˈbɪtər ˈmɛlən./
dialogue.zh: 等等，我們沒點苦瓜串啊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one is mine, I asked for it twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌn ɪz maɪn, aɪ æskt fɔr ɪt twaɪs./
dialogue.zh: 那串是我的，我跟他要過兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry, your bitter melon, one stick, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑri, jʊr ˈbɪtər ˈmɛlən, wʌn stɪk, raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，你的苦瓜，一串，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, and put it far from the chili.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt, ænd pʊt ɪt fɑr frʌm ðə ˈtʃɪli./
dialogue.zh: 對，還有把它放得離辣椒遠一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The chili jar sits on the low shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈtʃɪli dʒɑr sɪts ɑn ðə loʊ ʃɛlf./
dialogue.zh: 辣椒罐放在低矮那層架上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Low shelf, high heat, my eyes already water.
dialogue.phonetic: /loʊ ʃɛlf, haɪ hit, maɪ aɪz ɔlˈrɛdi ˈwɔtər./
dialogue.zh: 架子低、辣度高，我眼睛都流淚了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pass me the paper, the oil runs here.
dialogue.phonetic: /pæs mi ðə ˈpeɪpər, ðə ɔɪl rʌnz hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 紙巾遞給我，油在這裡滴。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Paper is gone, use your sleeve this once.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpeɪpər ɪz ɡɑn, juz jʊr sliv ðɪs wʌns./
dialogue.zh: 紙巾用光了，這次先用你的袖子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Someone left a whole bag of skewers.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmˌwʌn lɛft ə hoʊl bæɡ əv ˈskjʊrz./
dialogue.zh: 有人留下一整袋烤串。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bag of sticks only, the meat went home.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæɡ əv stɪks ˈoʊnli, ðə mit wɛnt hoʊm./
dialogue.zh: 袋子裡只剩竹簽，肉都被吃光了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look at the queue behind us now.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk æt ðə kju bɪˈhaɪnd ʌs naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 看看我們後面現在這一長排。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now it doubles, glad we ordered early.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ɪt ˈdəbəld, ɡlæd wi ˈɔrdərd ˈɜrli./
dialogue.zh: 現在又加倍，還好我們點得早。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Early? He came at seven, we at eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɜrli? hi keɪm æt ˈsɛvən, wi æt eɪt./
dialogue.zh: 算早嗎？他七點就來，我們八點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Seven was empty, the lights came on at eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛvən wʌz ˈɛmpti, ðə laɪts keɪm ɑn æt eɪt./
dialogue.zh: 七點還沒人，燈是八點才全開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Write our names on the bag, in case.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ˈaʊər neɪmz ɑn ðə bæɡ, ɪn keɪs./
dialogue.zh: 在紙袋上寫我們的名字，以防萬一。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In case of what? The bag stays with us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn keɪs əv wʌt? ðə bæɡ steɪz wɪð ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 以防什麼？袋子又不會離開我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The next batch smells like honey pork.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə nɛkst bætʃ smɛlz laɪk ˈhʌni pɔrk./
dialogue.zh: 下一爐聞起來像蜂蜜烤肉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Honey pork? Add two more sticks to us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhʌni pɔrk? æd tu mɔr stɪks tə ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 蜂蜜烤肉？幫我們再加兩串。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Add them before he closes the order sheet.
dialogue.phonetic: /æd ðɛm bɪˈfɔr hi ˈkloʊzəz ði ˈɔrdər ʃit./
dialogue.zh: 在他封單之前把兩串加進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sheet closed, he shakes his head at us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃit kloʊzd, hi ʃeɪks hɪz hɛd æt ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 單結了，他對著我們搖頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then we wait for the third round, fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi weɪt fɔr ðə θɜrd raʊnd, faɪn./
dialogue.zh: 那就等第三爐，沒關係。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fine with me, my hands are full already.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪn wɪð mi, maɪ hændz ɑr fʊl ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 我無所謂，反正我兩手都滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Third round brings the squid and the clam.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɜrd raʊnd brɪŋz ðə skwɪd ænd ðə klæm./
dialogue.zh: 第三輪烤的是魷魚和蛤蜊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clam? We cannot add, the sheet is closed.
dialogue.phonetic: /klæm? wi ˈkænɑt æd, ðə ʃit ɪz kloʊzd./
dialogue.zh: 蛤蜊？我們加不了了，單子結了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hot or cold, the shell holds the sand.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑt ɔr koʊld, ðə ʃɛl hoʊldz ðə sænd./
dialogue.zh: 不管冷或熱，殼裡總有沙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sand between teeth, the real night market prize.
dialogue.phonetic: /sænd bɪˈtwin titʃ, ðə ril naɪt ˈmɑrkɪt praɪz./
dialogue.zh: 牙縫裡的沙，才是夜市真正的獎品。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our number is called at last, let us move.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər ˈnʌmbər ɪz kɔld æt læst, lɛt ʌs muv./
dialogue.zh: 我們的號終於叫到了，過去吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Moving, my chair scraped across the road.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmuvɪŋ, maɪ tʃɛr skreɪpt əˈkrɔs ðə roʊd./
dialogue.zh: 過去了，我的椅子在地上刮一聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Last time, that cart blocked the whole row.
dialogue.phonetic: /læst taɪm, ðæt kɑrt blɑkt ðə hoʊl roʊ./
dialogue.zh: 上次那台推車擋住整排攤子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Row is clear now, the owner moved it back.
dialogue.phonetic: /roʊ ɪz klɪr naʊ, ði ˈoʊnər muvd ɪt bæk./
dialogue.zh: 現在通了，老闆把車推回去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not take the sticks from the front.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt teɪk ðə stɪks frʌm ðə frʌnt./
dialogue.zh: 別從最前面那排拿串。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: From the front they burn your fingers first.
dialogue.phonetic: /frʌm ðə frʌnt ðeɪ bɜrn jʊər ˈfɪŋɡərz fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 最前面那些會先燙到你的手指。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which end of the tray has the salted ones?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ ɛnd əv ðə treɪ hæz ðə ˈsɔltən wʌnz?/
dialogue.zh: 托盤哪一端放鹹的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Salted are left, spiced are near the fan.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɔltən ɑr lɛft, spaɪst ɑr nɪr ðə fæn./
dialogue.zh: 鹹的在左邊，香的那些靠風扇。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Left it is, and two spicy ones for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛft ɪt ɪz, ænd tu ˈspaɪsi wʌnz fɔr ju./
dialogue.zh: 那就左邊，再給你兩串辣的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep one, the chili jar is right over there.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip wʌn, ðə ˈtʃɪli dʒɑr ɪz raɪt ˈoʊvər ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 你留一串吧，辣椒罐就在那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here come the skewers, hot and stacked.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr kʌm ðə ˈskjʊrz, hɑt ænd stækt./
dialogue.zh: 烤串來了，還熱騰騰地堆著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stacked high, our whole order fills one plate.
dialogue.phonetic: /stækt haɪ, ˈaʊər hoʊl ˈɔrdər fɪlz wʌn pleɪt./
dialogue.zh: 堆得好高，我們點的剛好裝一盤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this skewer hot, or only colored?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɪs ˈskjʊr hɑt, ɔr ˈoʊnli ˈkʌldərd?/
dialogue.zh: 這串是辣的，還是只有紅色？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hot, that red pile is the second chili.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑt, ðæt rɛd paɪl ɪz ðə ˈsɛkənd ˈtʃɪli./
dialogue.zh: 辣的，那堆紅粉是第二道辣椒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How hot did you say this beef stick is?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ hɑt dɪd ju seɪ ðɪs bif stɪk ɪz?/
dialogue.zh: 你剛說這串牛肉有多辣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Medium, the owner adds sugar to tame it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmidjəm, ði ˈoʊnər ædz ˈʃʊɡər tə teɪm ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 中辣，老闆加糖去壓辣度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My tongue still tingles from that last one.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ tʌŋ stɪl ˈtɪŋɡəlz frʌm ðæt læst wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 我最後那一串吃得舌頭還在麻。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tingling means mild, you want the strong jar.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtɪŋkəlɪŋ minz maɪld, ju wɑnt ðə strɔŋ dʒɑr./
dialogue.zh: 會麻代表剛好，你要的是那罐重的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not dip twice, the sauce is vicious.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt dɪp twaɪs, ðə sɔs ɪz ˈvɪʃəs./
dialogue.zh: 別蘸兩次，那醬辣得很凶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Vicious how, the man beside me is crying.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈvɪʃəs haʊ, ðə mæn bəˈsaɪd mi ɪz ˈkraɪɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 凶到什麼程度？我旁邊那位都哭了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Point at the jar with the green cap, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɔɪnt æt ðə dʒɑr wɪð ðə ɡrin kæp, pliz./
dialogue.zh: 請指那罐綠蓋子的辣椒醬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Green is numbing, red is only burning.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡrin ɪz ˈnʌmbɪŋ, rɛd ɪz ˈoʊnli ˈbɜrnɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 綠的是麻口，紅的只是純辣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I taste one stick before choosing hot?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ teɪst wʌn stɪk bɪˈfɔr ˈtʃuzɪŋ hɑt?/
dialogue.zh: 我能先試一串再決定要不要辣的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, here is a toothpick, try the edge.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr, hɪr ɪz ə ˈtuθˌpɪk, traɪ ði ɛdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 當然，這根牙籤給你，先咬邊邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Start with a mild stick, then climb up.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɑrt wɪð ə maɪld stɪk, ðɛn klaɪm ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 先從不辣的串開始，再慢慢加辣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Climbing too fast wrecked my mouth last time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈklɪmbɪŋ tu fæst rɛkt maɪ maʊθ læst taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 上次我加辣太快，整張嘴都壞了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is the lamb here redder than the beef?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ ɪz ðə læm hɪr ˈrɛdər ðæn ðə bif?/
dialogue.zh: 這裡的羊肉為什麼比牛肉紅？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lamb takes two dips, beef only takes one.
dialogue.phonetic: /læm teɪks tu dɪps, bif ˈoʊnli teɪks wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 羊肉要蘸兩趟，牛肉只蘸一趟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sprinkle less powder, my throat is raw.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsprɪŋkəl lɛs ˈpaʊdər, maɪ θroʊt ɪz rɔ./
dialogue.zh: 胡椒粉少撒一點，我喉嚨好痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Raw throat? Then get the sesame stick.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɔ θroʊt? ðɛn ɡɛt ðə ˈsɛsəmi stɪk./
dialogue.zh: 喉嚨痛？那就點芝麻串。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is sesame mild enough for a first visit?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ˈsɛsəmi maɪld ɪˈnʌf fɔr ə fɜrst ˈvɪzɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 第一次來吃，芝麻的夠不嗆嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mild enough, it smells but never bites.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪld ɪˈnʌf, ɪt smɛlz bʌt ˈnɛvər baɪts./
dialogue.zh: 夠溫和，它只有香味不會咬人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That chili cloud drifted over our table.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈtʃɪli klaʊd ˈdrɪftəd ˈoʊvər ˈaʊər ˈteɪbəl./
dialogue.zh: 那團辣椒煙飄到我們桌上來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Drifted right into my nose, thanks a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdrɪftəd raɪt ˈɪntu maɪ noʊz, θæŋks ə lɑt./
dialogue.zh: 根本飄進我鼻子了，真是謝謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Water, quick, the whole stick was pepper.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɔtər, kwɪk, ðə hoʊl stɪk wʌz ˈpɛpər./
dialogue.zh: 快給我水，整串都是胡椒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Water only spreads it, eat the rice ball.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɔtər ˈoʊnli spɛrz ɪt, it ðə raɪs bɔl./
dialogue.zh: 喝水只會把辣散開，吃飯糰。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The seller never warns anybody, he just grins.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈsɛlər ˈnɛvər wɔrnz ˈɛniˌbɑdi, hi dʒʌst ɡrɪnz./
dialogue.zh: 賣炭烤的從不提醒人，只會笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Grinning is his trick, and we always bite.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɡrɪnɪŋ ɪz hɪz trɪk, ænd wi ˈɔlˌweɪz baɪt./
dialogue.zh: 笑就是他的招，我們每次都上當。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do you ask for no chili at all?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du ju æsk fɔr noʊ ˈtʃɪli æt ɔl?/
dialogue.zh: 要怎麼跟他說完全不要辣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say clear, show the jar, then shake your hand.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪ klɪr, ʃoʊ ðə dʒɑr, ðɛn ʃeɪk jʊr hænd./
dialogue.zh: 講清楚，指那罐辣椒，再擺手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nothing on this one, just salt and time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌθɪŋ ɑn ðɪs wʌn, dʒʌst sɔlt ænd taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 這串什麼都不加，只有鹽和火候。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Salt alone still costs the same as hot.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɔlt əˈloʊn stɪl kɔsts ðə seɪm æz hɑt./
dialogue.zh: 只放鹽的價格跟辣的一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your lips look swollen from that stick.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr lɪps lʊk ˈswoʊlən frʌm ðæt stɪk./
dialogue.zh: 你吃完那串嘴唇都腫了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Swollen, but the next one goes deeper in chili.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈswoʊlən, bʌt ðə nɛkst wʌn ɡoʊz ˈkipər ɪn ˈtʃɪli./
dialogue.zh: 腫歸腫，下一串我要蘸更深。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deeper is not brave, it is just expensive.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkipər ɪz nɑt breɪv, ɪt ɪz dʒʌst ɪkˈspɛnsɪv./
dialogue.zh: 蘸深不算勇敢，只是很花錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Expensive? I asked for a milk tea already.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈspɛnsɪv? aɪ æskt fɔr ə mɪlk ti ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 花錢？我已經先點了一杯奶茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Milk tea puts out the fire best of all.
dialogue.phonetic: /mɪlk ti pʊts aʊt ðə faɪr bɛst əv ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 滅火的還是奶茶最有效。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two carts down, that is the best tea here.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu kɑrts daʊn, ðæt ɪz ðə bɛst ti hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 就在兩攤後面，那家的茶最好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do chilies burn the same on every stick?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ˈtʃɪliz bɜrn ðə seɪm ɑn ˈɛvri stɪk?/
dialogue.zh: 每串上的辣度都一樣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, fat carries heat, lean meat does not.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, fæt ˈkæriz hit, lin mit dʌz nɑt./
dialogue.zh: 不會，肥肉把辣帶起來，瘦肉不會。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lean then, and keep the fat for my friend.
dialogue.phonetic: /lin ðɛn, ænd kip ðə fæt fɔr maɪ frɛnd./
dialogue.zh: 那我吃瘦的，肥的留給我朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your friend asked for the hottest jar yesterday.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr frɛnd æskt fɔr ðə ˈhoʊtɪst dʒɑr ˈjɛstərˌdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 你朋友昨天就要了最辣那罐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yesterday he cried, today he orders again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈjɛstərˌdeɪ hi kraɪd, təˈdeɪ hi ˈɔrdərz əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 昨天他辣到哭，今天又來點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That kind of cry counts as a good review.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt kaɪnd əv kraɪ kaʊnts æz ə ɡʊd rɪˈvju./
dialogue.zh: 那種哭法就等於給了他五星好評。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good reviews here always smell like smoke.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd rɪˈvjuz hɪr ˈɔlˌweɪz smɛl laɪk smoʊk./
dialogue.zh: 這裡的好評聞起來都帶著煙味。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smoke in the eyes, chili on the shirt, perfect.
dialogue.phonetic: /smoʊk ɪn ði aɪz, ˈtʃɪli ɑn ðər ʃɜrt, ˈpɜrfɪkt./
dialogue.zh: 眼睛進煙、衣服沾辣醬，就完美了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who designed this bench so close to the grill?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu dɪˈzaɪnd ðɪs bɛntʃ soʊ kloʊs tə ðə ɡrɪl?/
dialogue.zh: 誰把長椅擺得離烤架這麼近？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nobody, the cart moved closer while we ate.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊbədi, ðə kɑrt muvd ˈkloʊsər waɪl wi et./
dialogue.zh: 沒人刻意，是我們吃的時候攤車移近了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pick our spice level, one to five.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɪk ˈaʊər spaɪs ˈlɛvəl, wʌn tə faɪv./
dialogue.zh: 選我們的辣度，一到五。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five for you, three for me, that is fair.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv fɔr ju, θri fɔr mi, ðæt ɪz fɛr./
dialogue.zh: 你五、我三，這樣公平。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five means the fan blows your tears away.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv minz ðə fæn bloʊz jʊr tɪrz əˈweɪ./
dialogue.zh: 選五的就等於讓風扇把你的眼淚吹乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The fan is part of eating level five.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə fæn ɪz pɑrt əv ˈitɪŋ ˈlɛvəl faɪv./
dialogue.zh: 那台風扇本來就是吃五辣的一部分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Level four left my mouth numb for an hour.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɛvəl fɔr lɛft maɪ maʊθ nʌm fɔr an ˈaʊər./
dialogue.zh: 四辣讓我的嘴麻了一小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: An hour? Mine stayed numb till the hotel.
dialogue.phonetic: /æn ˈaʊər? maɪn steɪd nʌm tɪl ðə hoʊˈtɛl./
dialogue.zh: 一小時？我麻到回旅館才退。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The hotel is far, we need water first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə hoʊˈtɛl ɪz fɑr, wi nid ˈwɔtər fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 旅館還很遠，我們得先找水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First stop is the corner store, right there.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrst stɑp ɪz ðə ˈkɔrnər stor, raɪt ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 第一站是路口那間便利店，就在那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bring back two cold ones, no spice there.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ bæk tu koʊld wʌnz, noʊ spaɪs ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 帶兩瓶冰的回來，那邊不賣辣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No spice, no tears, and no burning tongue.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ spaɪs, noʊ tɪrz, ænd noʊ ˈbɜrnɪŋ tʌŋ./
dialogue.zh: 沒辣、沒眼淚，舌頭也不會燒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: After this cart my tongue feels two sizes big.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈæftər ðɪs kɑrt maɪ tʌŋ filz tu ˈsaɪzəz bɪɡ./
dialogue.zh: 吃了這攤，我的舌頭腫得像大了兩號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two sizes big is normal here, eat slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈsaɪzəz bɪɡ ɪz ˈnɔrməl hɪr, it ˈsloʊli./
dialogue.zh: 在這裡舌頭腫兩號算正常，慢慢吃就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Slowly? I inhaled four sticks in one minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsloʊli? aɪ ɪnˈheɪld fɔr stɪks ɪn wʌn ˈmɪnɪt./
dialogue.zh: 慢慢吃？我一分鐘就吞了四串。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The smoke did half the cooking, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə smoʊk dɪd hæf ðə ˈkʊkɪŋ, ˈɑnəstli./
dialogue.zh: 說真的，那煙也幫你烤了一半。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Charcoal brings the flavor, chili brings the pain.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtʃɑrˌkoʊl brɪŋz ðə ˈfleɪvər, ˈtʃɪli brɪŋz ðə peɪn./
dialogue.zh: 炭火帶來香味，辣椒帶來痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pain I can take, the flavor is the point.
dialogue.phonetic: /peɪn aɪ kæn teɪk, ðə ˈfleɪvər ɪz ðə pɔɪnt./
dialogue.zh: 痛我撐得住，香味才是重點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The point is the pink light over that stall.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə pɔɪnt ɪz ðə pɪŋk laɪt ˈoʊvər ðæt stɔl./
dialogue.zh: 重點是那攤上方的粉紅燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That pink bulb marks the spiciest cart tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt pɪŋk bʌlb mɑrks ðə ˈspaɪsiəst kɑrt təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 那顆粉紅燈泡代表今晚最辣的車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tonight the spicy cart has its own line.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈnaɪt ðə ˈspaɪsi kɑrt hæz ɪts oʊn laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 今晚那攤辣的居然自己排起了隊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Its line moves slow, everyone tastes first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts laɪn muvz sloʊ, ˈɛvriˌwʌn teɪsts fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 那隊伍動得慢，因為每個人都先試辣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tasting costs nothing, so the owner allows it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈteɪstɪŋ kɔsts ˈnʌθɪŋ, soʊ ði ˈoʊnər əˈlaʊz ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 試吃不要錢，所以老闆讓人試。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Allows one toothpick, then he watches you buy.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈlaʊz wʌn ˈtuθˌpɪk, ðɛn hi ˈwɑtʃəz ju baɪ./
dialogue.zh: 只給一根牙籤，然後盯著你會不會買。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: C twelve, the tea stall ticket in my hand.
dialogue.phonetic: /si twɛlv, ðə ti stɔl ˈtɪkɪt ɪn maɪ hænd./
dialogue.zh: 十二號，茶水攤那張號碼牌在我手上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one buys tea, ours still says B nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌn baɪz ti, ˈaʊərz stɪl sɛz bi naɪn./
dialogue.zh: 那張只買得到茶，我們這張是九號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: B nine it is, and he reads extra hot.
dialogue.phonetic: /bi naɪn ɪt ɪz, ænd hi ridz ˈɛkstrə hɑt./
dialogue.zh: 就是九號，他大聲念出加辣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Extra hot? Then run, the grill is already on.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛkstrə hɑt? ðɛn rʌn, ðə ɡrɪl ɪz ɔlˈrɛdi ɑn./
dialogue.zh: 加了辣？那快跑，爐子已經開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Already on it, no time to change the level.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔlˈrɛdi ɑn ɪt, noʊ taɪm tə tʃeɪndʒ ðə ˈlɛvəl./
dialogue.zh: 已經下爐了，來不及改辣度。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Change it after, dip half in the cool sauce.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃeɪndʒ ɪt ˈæftər, dɪp hæf ɪn ðə kul sɔs./
dialogue.zh: 之後再補救，半串蘸涼醬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The blue lid jar holds the cool sauce.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə blu lɪd dʒɑr hoʊldz ðə kul sɔs./
dialogue.zh: 藍蓋子那罐裝的是涼醬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blue lid, blue tongue, do not trust that one.
dialogue.phonetic: /blu lɪd, blu tʌŋ, du nɑt trʌst ðæt wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 藍蓋、藍舌頭，那罐別信。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Trust the green jar, it cools without dying.
dialogue.phonetic: /trʌst ðə ɡrin dʒɑr, ɪt kuls wɪˈðaʊt ˈdaɪɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 信那罐綠的，涼得快又不會要命。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dying is strong, but yes, my mouth thanks you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdaɪɪŋ ɪz strɔŋ, bʌt jɛs, maɪ maʊθ θæŋks ju./
dialogue.zh: 要命是誇張了，不過我嘴巴謝謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which stick did you pick, long or short?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ stɪk dɪd ju pɪk, lɔŋ ɔr ʃɔrt?/
dialogue.zh: 你挑了長串還是短串？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Short one, more chili per bite, he told me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃɔrt wʌn, mɔr ˈtʃɪli pɜr baɪt, hi toʊld mi./
dialogue.zh: 短的，他說一口辣更多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He tells everybody that, then laughs loudly.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi tɛlz ˈɛvriˌbɑdi ðæt, ðɛn læfz ˈlaʊdli./
dialogue.zh: 他見人就那麼說，然後大笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Loudly, over the drum and the blender noise.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlaʊdli, ˈoʊvər ðə drʌm ænd ðə ˈblɛndər nɔɪz./
dialogue.zh: 大聲到蓋過那面鼓和冰機的聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The drink stall next to us saves every meal.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə drɪŋk stɔl nɛkst tə ʌs seɪvz ˈɛvri mil./
dialogue.zh: 我們旁邊那攤飲料的，救了好幾餐。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Those two cold teas, and we are saved.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðoz tu koʊld tiz, ænd wi ər seɪvd./
dialogue.zh: 就是那兩杯冰茶，我們得救了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ice melts fast on this hot pavement, though.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪs mɛlts fæst ɑn ðɪs hɑt ˈpeɪvmənt, ðoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 不過冰在發燙的地面上化超快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Though or not, bring it before it becomes soup.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðoʊ ɔr nɑt, brɪŋ ɪt bɪˈfɔr ɪt bɪˈkʌmz sup./
dialogue.zh: 不管怎樣，在它變成湯之前端回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Soup or not, that chili really grew on me.
dialogue.phonetic: /sup ɔr nɑt, ðæt ˈtʃɪli ˈrɪli ɡru ɑn mi./
dialogue.zh: 先不管湯，那個辣我越吃越愛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Grew on you? Mine still burns from the first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡru ɑn ju? maɪn stɪl bɜrnz frʌm ðə fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 你愛上了？我從第一串開始還辣著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You swore twice and still asked for more.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju skɔr twaɪs ænd stɪl æskt fɔr mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 你罵了兩次，還是繼續加點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: More came, and the whole table clapped for us.
dialogue.phonetic: /mɔr keɪm, ænd ðə hoʊl ˈteɪbəl klæpt fɔr ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 串真的來了，整桌人還替我們拍手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Clapping drew the stall cat over here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈklæpɪŋ dru ðə stɔl kæt ˈoʊvər hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 拍手聲把那攤的貓引過來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The cat wants fish skewers, not our lamb.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kæt wɑnts fɪʃ ˈskjʊrz, nɑt ˈaʊər læm./
dialogue.zh: 那貓要的是魚串，不是我們的羊肉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fish stick for the cat, one small favor.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɪʃ stɪk fɔr ðə kæt, wʌn smɔl ˈfeɪvər./
dialogue.zh: 給貓一串魚，算是幫個小忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Favors cost money here, the man is watching.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfeɪvərz kɔst ˈmʌni hɪr, ðə mæn ɪz ˈwɑtʃɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 在這裡做人情是要錢的，他正看著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Watching or not, he slipped one to the cat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɑtʃɪŋ ɔr nɑt, hi slɪpt wʌn tə ðə kæt./
dialogue.zh: 他看著也照樣偷塞一串給貓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The cat ate it plain, no chili for him.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kæt et ɪt pleɪn, noʊ ˈtʃɪli fɔr hɪm./
dialogue.zh: 貓吃原味，它那一串沒沾辣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Plain suits him, we need the last hot batch.
dialogue.phonetic: /pleɪn suts hɪm, wi nid ðə læst hɑt bætʃ./
dialogue.zh: 牠適合清淡的，我們要最後一爐辣的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Get the fried cake beside it, bread stops heat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɛt ðə fraɪd keɪk bəˈsaɪd ɪt, brɛd stɑps hit./
dialogue.zh: 順便買旁邊的炸油餅，麵食能解辣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fried cake in chili sauce, yes or no?
dialogue.phonetic: /fraɪd keɪk ɪn ˈtʃɪli sɔs, jɛs ɔr noʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 炸油餅要蘸辣醬嗎，要還不要？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes twice, the vendor already heard you.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs twaɪs, ði ˈvɛndər ɔlˈrɛdi hɜrd ju./
dialogue.zh: 兩次都要，攤販已經聽到你說了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Every long table here is already taken.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvri lɔŋ ˈteɪbəl hɪr ɪz ɔlˈrɛdi ˈteɪkən./
dialogue.zh: 這裡的長桌全都被佔了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not that one, two seats sit empty yet.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ðæt wʌn, tu sits sɪt ˈɛmpti jɛt./
dialogue.zh: 那張還沒有，還有兩個位子空著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sit empty on the side with the trash bucket?
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪt ˈɛmpti ɑn ðə saɪd wɪð ðə træʃ ˈbʌkɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 空位是在有竹簽桶的那一邊嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That side, yes, the bucket gets swept often.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt saɪd, jɛs, ðə ˈbʌkɪt ɡɛts swɛpt ˈɔfən./
dialogue.zh: 就是那邊，桶子常常有人清。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Swept by whom? The man stacked sticks high.
dialogue.phonetic: /swɛpt baɪ hum? ðə mæn stækt stɪks haɪ./
dialogue.zh: 誰清的？那邊的串都堆好高了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: By the auntie with the spray bottle, look.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ði ˈænti wɪð ðə spreɪ ˈbɑtəl, lʊk./
dialogue.zh: 是那個拿噴水瓶的阿媽，你看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ask the auntie if we can share the bench.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk ði ˈænti ɪf wi kæn ʃɛr ðə bɛntʃ./
dialogue.zh: 問一下阿媽能不能共用那張長椅。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She already moved her bag to the end.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi ɔlˈrɛdi muvd hɜr bæɡ tə ði ɛnd./
dialogue.zh: 她已經把袋子挪到桌子末端了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Moved it herself, that is a welcome sign.
dialogue.phonetic: /muvd ɪt hɜrˈsɛlf, ðæt ɪz ə ˈwɛlkəm saɪn./
dialogue.zh: 她自己挪的，那就是歡迎我們坐。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit down fast before she changes her mind.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪt daʊn fæst bɪˈfɔr ʃi ˈtʃeɪndʒəz hɜr maɪnd./
dialogue.zh: 快坐下，別等她改變心意。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bench is warm from the last group of eaters.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɛntʃ ɪz wɔrm frʌm ðə læst ɡrup əv ˈitərz./
dialogue.zh: 長椅還是暖的，上一群人剛坐過。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Warm benches are the best thing after dark.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm ˈbɛntʃəz ɑr ðə bɛst θɪŋ ˈæftər dɑrk./
dialogue.zh: 天黑以後，最棒的就是暖板凳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two more sticks and we have to move tables.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu mɔr stɪks ænd wi hæv tə muv ˈteɪbəlz./
dialogue.zh: 再吃兩串我們就得換桌了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Move where? This is the last long table left.
dialogue.phonetic: /muv wɛr? ðɪs ɪz ðə læst lɔŋ ˈteɪbəl lɛft./
dialogue.zh: 換到哪？這是最後一張長桌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Left or not, a family heads this way.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛft ɔr nɑt, ə ˈfæməli hɛdz ðɪs weɪ./
dialogue.zh: 不管是不是最後一張，一家人朝這邊走來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six of them, and this bench holds four.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks əv ðɛm, ænd ðɪs bɛntʃ hoʊldz fɔr./
dialogue.zh: 六個人，但這張椅只坐得下四個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four only? Then squeeze in, knees together.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr ˈoʊnli? ðɛn skwiz ɪn, niz təˈɡɛðər./
dialogue.zh: 四個就好？那擠一擠，膝蓋貼膝蓋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Together is fine, the table is sticky anyway.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈɡɛðər ɪz faɪn, ðə ˈteɪbəl ɪz ˈstɪki ˈɛniˌweɪ./
dialogue.zh: 擠沒關係，反正桌面是黏的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Anyway, wipe it with two napkins first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛniˌweɪ, waɪp ɪt wɪð tu ˈnæpkɪnz fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 總之先用兩張紙巾擦一擦。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Napkins came from the stall, remember the corner.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnæpkɪnz keɪm frʌm ðə stɔl, rɪˈmɛmbər ðə ˈkɔrnər./
dialogue.zh: 紙巾是攤子上拿的，記得那個角落。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Corner by the sauce jars, right, I got two.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɔrnər baɪ ðə sɔs dʒɑrz, raɪt, aɪ ɡɑt tu./
dialogue.zh: 醬料罐那個角落，對，我拿了兩張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, one for the table, one for your lap.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, wʌn fɔr ðə ˈteɪbəl, wʌn fɔr jʊr læp./
dialogue.zh: 好，一張擦桌子，一張墊大腿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lap is where the chili powder lands anyway.
dialogue.phonetic: /læp ɪz wɛr ðə ˈtʃɪli ˈpaʊdər lændz ˈɛniˌweɪ./
dialogue.zh: 反正辣椒粉最後都會落在大腿上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Brush it off, that man already has marks.
dialogue.phonetic: /brʌʃ ɪt ɔf, ðæt mæn ɔlˈrɛdi hæz mɑrks./
dialogue.zh: 撥掉吧，你那件衣服已經有痕跡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Under the table, someone dropped a whole stick.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʌndər ðə ˈteɪbəl, ˈsʌmˌwʌn drɑpt ə hoʊl stɪk./
dialogue.zh: 桌子底下有人掉了整整一串。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dropped it clean, no one will claim it now.
dialogue.phonetic: /drɑpt ɪt klin, noʊ wʌn wɪl kleɪm ɪt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 掉得乾乾淨淨，現在沒人會認領。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Claim it? A kid is staring at that stick.
dialogue.phonetic: /kleɪm ɪt? ə kɪd ɪz ˈstɛrɪŋ æt ðæt stɪk./
dialogue.zh: 沒人認領？有個小孩一直盯著那串。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give it to him, his mother is smiling.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɪv ɪt tə hɪm, hɪz ˈmʌðər ɪz ˈsmaɪlɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 給他吧，他媽媽正在對我們笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shared bench means sharing the bucket too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃɛrd bɛntʃ minz ˈʃɛrɪŋ ðə ˈbʌkɪt tu./
dialogue.zh: 共用的椅子也表示要共用竹簽桶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bucket is theirs, ours sits by the pole.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈbʌkɪt ɪz ðɛrz, ˈaʊərz sɪts baɪ ðə poʊl./
dialogue.zh: 那桶是他們的，我們的在燈柱邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: By the pole is fine, the light is better.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ðə poʊl ɪz faɪn, ðə laɪt ɪz ˈbɛtər./
dialogue.zh: 燈柱邊也好，光線比較亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better light shows how much grease we wear.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɛtər laɪt ʃoʊz haʊ mʌtʃ ɡris wi wɛr./
dialogue.zh: 光線一亮就看得出我們身上多少油。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We wear it like a badge, this night market.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi wɛr ɪt laɪk ə bædʒ, ðɪs naɪt ˈmɑrkɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我們把夜市的味道當成勳章穿著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, a badge made of smoke and sauce.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔrs, ə bædʒ meɪd əv smoʊk ænd sɔs./
dialogue.zh: 當然，那勳章是用煙和醬做的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Made or bought, our food arrives on one plate.
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪd ɔr bɔt, ˈaʊər fud əˈraɪvz ɑn wʌn pleɪt./
dialogue.zh: 不管是怎麼做的，我們吃的都放在一盤上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One plate, two hands, and no space for elbows.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn pleɪt, tu hændz, ænd noʊ speɪs fɔr ˈɛlˌboʊz./
dialogue.zh: 一盤、兩手，手肘完全沒地方放。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Elbows up, the man across eats like a machine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛlˌboʊz ʌp, ðə mæn əˈkrɔs its laɪk ə məˈʃin./
dialogue.zh: 手肘抬起來，對面那男的吃得像機器。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A machine with twenty sticks already gone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə məˈʃin wɪð ˈtwɛnti stɪks ɔlˈrɛdi ɡɔn./
dialogue.zh: 一台已經吃掉二十串的機器。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Gone in ten minutes, he does not even talk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑn ɪn tɛn ˈmɪnɪts, hi dʌz nɑt ˈivən tɔk./
dialogue.zh: 十分鐘就吃光，他連話都不說。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Talking slows the mouth, he knows the trick.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtɔkɪŋ sloʊz ðə maʊθ, hi noʊz ðə trɪk./
dialogue.zh: 說話會拖慢嘴巴，他懂這個訣竅。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Trick or not, pass me the garlic stick.
dialogue.phonetic: /trɪk ɔr nɑt, pæs mi ðə ˈɡɑrlɪk stɪk./
dialogue.zh: 不管有沒有訣竅，把蒜味那串遞給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Garlic is yours, I took the last cheese one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɡɑrlɪk ɪz jʊrz, aɪ tʊk ðə læst tʃiz wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 蒜味的是你的，我拿最後的起司串。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One cheese each is fair, count with me.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn tʃiz itʃ ɪz fɛr, kaʊnt wɪð mi./
dialogue.zh: 一人一串起司很公平，跟我一起數。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Counting at a shared table looks funny.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkaʊntɪŋ æt ə ʃɛrd ˈteɪbəl lʊks ˈfʌni./
dialogue.zh: 在共用的桌子前數來數去很好笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Funny is fine, the auntie counts our sticks too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfʌni ɪz faɪn, ði ˈænti kaʊnts ˈaʊər stɪks tu./
dialogue.zh: 好笑沒關係，阿媽也在數我們的簽子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She counts by bucket, not by plate, relax.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi kaʊnts baɪ ˈbʌkɪt, nɑt baɪ pleɪt, rɪˈlæks./
dialogue.zh: 她是用桶子數的，不是盤子，放輕鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bucket math works, we asked for twenty sticks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbʌkɪt mæθ wɜrks, wi æskt fɔr ˈtwɛnti stɪks./
dialogue.zh: 用桶子數也行，我們要了二十串。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty asked, but the bucket says twenty two.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti æskt, bʌt ðə ˈbʌkɪt sɛz ˈtwɛnti tu./
dialogue.zh: 點的是二十串，桶子裡數到二十二。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two extra sticks, ask him or just eat them?
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈɛkstrə stɪks, æsk hɪm ɔr dʒʌst it ðɛm?/
dialogue.zh: 多出兩串，要問他還是直接吃？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eat them, his head stays buried in smoke.
dialogue.phonetic: /it ðɛm, hɪz hɛd steɪz ˈbɛrid ɪn smoʊk./
dialogue.zh: 吃一吃啦，他埋頭在煙裡忙著呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Buried in smoke, we owe him two sticks now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɛrid ɪn smoʊk, wi oʊ hɪm tu stɪks naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 他埋頭在煙裡，那兩串是我們欠他的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Owe him two, and put them on her paper.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ hɪm tu, ænd pʊt ðɛm ɑn hɜr ˈpeɪpər./
dialogue.zh: 欠他兩串，就一起算進她那張單子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Remember the last table we shared like this?
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈmɛmbər ðə læst ˈteɪbəl wi ʃɛrd laɪk ðɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 還記得上次我們這樣跟人共桌嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The station one, and we missed the last train.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈsteɪʃən wʌn, ænd wi mɪst ðə læst treɪn./
dialogue.zh: 記得，車站那攤，結果我們錯過了末班車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Missed the train, but we found this night market.
dialogue.phonetic: /mɪst ðə treɪn, bʌt wi faʊnd ðɪs naɪt ˈmɑrkɪt./
dialogue.zh: 錯過了火車，卻找到了這個夜市。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Found it, found a bench, found one spare stool.
dialogue.phonetic: /faʊnd ɪt, faʊnd ə bɛntʃ, faʊnd wʌn spɛr stul./
dialogue.zh: 找到了夜市，找到了長椅，還多一張備用塑膠椅。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Spare stool for the lady with the baby?
dialogue.phonetic: /spɛr stul fɔr ðə ˈleɪdi wɪð ðə ˈbeɪbi?/
dialogue.zh: 多那張椅子是要留給抱嬰兒的小姐嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She will say no, babies sleep on laps here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi wɪl seɪ noʊ, ˈbeɪbiz slip ɑn læp hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 她會拒絕的，這裡的嬰兒都睡在大腿上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here every lap holds a child or a bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ˈɛvri læp hoʊldz ə tʃaɪld ɔr ə bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 在這裡不是孩子就是袋子壓著腿。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My bag holds wet wipes, the child holds nothing.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ bæɡ hoʊldz wɛt waɪps, ðə tʃaɪld hoʊldz ˈnʌθɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 我的包裡是濕紙巾，那小孩兩手空空。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nothing at all? That child will grab a skewer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌθɪŋ ət ɔl? ðæt tʃaɪld wɪl ɡræb ə ˈskjʊr./
dialogue.zh: 兩手空空？那小孩會去抓烤串。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Grab the soft end, lamb sticks are too hot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡræb ðə sɔft ɛnd, læm stɪks ɑr tu hɑt./
dialogue.zh: 讓他抓軟的那頭，羊肉串太辣了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Too hot for a child, perfect for us two.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu hɑt fɔr ə tʃaɪld, ˈpɜrfɪkt fɔr ʌs tu./
dialogue.zh: 小孩吃太辣，是我們兩個剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Us two, plus this stranger passing the peanuts.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌs tu, plʌs ðɪs ˈstreɪndʒər ˈpæsɪŋ ðə ˈpinʌts./
dialogue.zh: 我們兩個，外加這位遞花生的陌生人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Passing peanuts? On a shared table, sure.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpæsɪŋ ˈpinʌts? ɑn ə ʃɛrd ˈteɪbəl, ʃʊr./
dialogue.zh: 在共用的桌子上分花生？當然可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Night market rules say food moves around here.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪt ˈmɑrkɪt rulz seɪ fud muvz əˈraʊnd hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 夜市的規矩就是吃食要在桌間傳來傳去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Around here, a bag of chips travels far.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈraʊnd hɪr, ə bæɡ əv tʃɪps ˈtrævəlz fɑr./
dialogue.zh: 在這附近，一包洋芋片會傳很遠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It always comes back empty, that is the rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈɔlˌweɪz kʌmz bæk ˈɛmpti, ðæt ɪz ðə rul./
dialogue.zh: 它回來時永遠是空的，這就是規矩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rule accepted, here go our extra napkins.
dialogue.phonetic: /rul əkˈsɛptɪd, hɪr ɡoʊ ˈaʊər ˈɛkstrə ˈnæpkɪnz./
dialogue.zh: 規矩我收，多餘的紙巾也給你們。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Accepted with thanks, want the corner seat next time?
dialogue.phonetic: /əkˈsɛptɪd wɪθ θæŋks, wɑnt ðə ˈkɔrnər sit nɛkst taɪm?/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝收下，下次想要轉角那個位子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next time we come earlier, nine sharp.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst taɪm wi kʌm ˈɜrliər, naɪn ʃɑrp./
dialogue.zh: 下次我們早一點來，九點整。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine sharp means a table with a real chair.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn ʃɑrp minz ə ˈteɪbəl wɪð ə ril tʃɛr./
dialogue.zh: 九點整就有桌子還有真正的椅子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Real chairs cost extra, the plastic ones are free.
dialogue.phonetic: /ril tʃɛrz kɔst ˈɛkstrə, ðə ˈplæstɪk wʌnz ɑr fri./
dialogue.zh: 真椅子要多錢，塑膠椅是免費的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Free plastic cracked under that big guy earlier.
dialogue.phonetic: /fri ˈplæstɪk krækt ˈʌndər ðæt bɪɡ ɡaɪ ˈɜrliər./
dialogue.zh: 剛才那塊免費塑膠椅在一個大個子下面裂了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cracked plastic, and he just bought another stool.
dialogue.phonetic: /krækt ˈplæstɪk, ænd hi dʒʌst bɔt əˈnʌðər stul./
dialogue.zh: 塑膠椅裂了，他直接再買一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For the stall, of course, nobody takes stools home.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr ðə stɔl, əv kɔrs, ˈnoʊbədi teɪks stulz hoʊm./
dialogue.zh: 當然賠給攤子，沒人會把椅子帶回家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Home is far, so we stay on this bench.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊm ɪz fɑr, soʊ wi steɪ ɑn ðɪs bɛntʃ./
dialogue.zh: 家離得遠，所以我們留在這張長椅上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This bench holds four, and now holds eleven.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs bɛntʃ hoʊldz fɔr, ænd naʊ hoʊldz ɪˈlɛvən./
dialogue.zh: 這椅子設計坐四個，現在擠了十一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eleven people on one bench is a miracle.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪˈlɛvən ˈpipəl ɑn wʌn bɛntʃ ɪz ə ˈmɪrəkəl./
dialogue.zh: 一張長椅擠十一個人簡直是奇蹟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A miracle with skewers, hold my cup please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈmɪrəkəl wɪð ˈskjʊrz, hoʊld maɪ kʌp pliz./
dialogue.zh: 有烤串的奇蹟，先幫我扶著杯子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take it, I am wiping sauce off my phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ɪt, aɪ æm ˈwaɪpɪŋ sɔs ɔf maɪ foʊn./
dialogue.zh: 你拿一下，我在擦手機上的醬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here is a napkin, the screen needs two.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪz ə ˈnæpkɪn, ðə skrin nidz tu./
dialogue.zh: 給你一張紙巾，擦螢幕要用兩張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First the sticky part, pass the wet wipe.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrst ðə ˈstɪki pɑrt, pæs ðə wɛt waɪp./
dialogue.zh: 先處理黏的部分，把濕紙巾給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wipe gone, use the edge of the paper map.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪp ɡɔn, juz ði ɛdʒ əv ðə ˈpeɪpər mæp./
dialogue.zh: 濕紙巾用完了，用那張地圖的邊角擦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Map says this street empties out at eleven.
dialogue.phonetic: /mæp sɛz ðɪs strit ˈɛmptiz aʊt æt ɪˈlɛvən./
dialogue.zh: 地圖上寫這條街十一點就清空。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At eleven the stools start folding, watch us.
dialogue.phonetic: /æt ɪˈlɛvən ðə stulz stɑrt ˈfoʊldɪŋ, wɑtʃ ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 十一點椅子就開始收，看我們來不來得及。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Folding stools means we finish fast tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfoʊldɪŋ stulz minz wi ˈfɪnɪʃ fæst təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 椅子要收，就表示我們今晚得吃快點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tonight we finish warm, the grill stays open.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈnaɪt wi ˈfɪnɪʃ wɔrm, ðə ɡrɪl steɪz ˈoʊpən./
dialogue.zh: 今晚我們會在暖呼呼的時候吃完，爐子還不關。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Open late is why the tables stay greasy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊpən leɪt ɪz waɪ ðə ˈteɪbəlz steɪ ˈɡrisi./
dialogue.zh: 開得晚就是桌子一直油膩的原因。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Greasy tables, happy mouths, clean hands never.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɡrisi ˈteɪbəlz, ˈhæpi maʊθs, klin hændz ˈnɛvər./
dialogue.zh: 油油桌子、開心嘴巴，乾淨的手就沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Never clean here, the sink is for the owner.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɛvər klin hɪr, ðə sɪŋk ɪz fɔr ði ˈoʊnər./
dialogue.zh: 這裡的水槽是老闆用的，客人不能洗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Owner's sink, our wet wipes, that is the deal.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnərz sɪŋk, ˈaʊər wɛt waɪps, ðæt ɪz ðə dil./
dialogue.zh: 老闆的水槽加我們的濕紙巾，就是全部條件。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deal accepted, the kids left us two stools.
dialogue.phonetic: /dil əkˈsɛptɪd, ðə kɪdz lɛft ʌs tu stulz./
dialogue.zh: 成交，那群小孩留下了兩張塑膠椅。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Left them warm, sit quick before the family returns.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛft ðɛm wɔrm, sɪt kwɪk bɪˈfɔr ðə ˈfæməli rɪˈtɜrnz./
dialogue.zh: 椅子還溫的，趁那家人回來前快坐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: With six they will need the bench back fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪθ sɪks ðeɪ wɪl nid ðə bɛntʃ bæk fæst./
dialogue.zh: 六個人回來，一下就要把長椅坐滿。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we eat standing, like the corner regulars.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi it ˈstændɪŋ, laɪk ðə ˈkɔrnər ˈrɛɡjəˌlərz./
dialogue.zh: 那我們就站著吃，像路口那些老客人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Regulars stand and eat in two bites.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɛɡjəˌlərz stænd ænd it ɪn tu baɪts./
dialogue.zh: 老客人站著，兩口就把一串解決。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two bites, one stick, then back for more.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu baɪts, wʌn stɪk, ðɛn bæk fɔr mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 兩口一串，吃完再回去拿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Orders made, we found our corner of the bench.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔrdərz meɪd, wi faʊnd ˈaʊər ˈkɔrnər əv ðə bɛntʃ./
dialogue.zh: 點完單，我們也在長椅上找到一角。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Corner secured, put your elbow where it fits.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɔrnər sɪˈkjʊrd, pʊt jʊr ˈɛlˌboʊ wɛr ɪt fɪts./
dialogue.zh: 位置搶好了，手肘能找到地方就放下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many sticks did the auntie count?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni stɪks dɪd ði ˈænti kaʊnt?/
dialogue.zh: 阿媽數了多少根竹簽？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty two, she read them off the bucket.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti tu, ʃi rɛd ðɛm ɔf ðə ˈbʌkɪt./
dialogue.zh: 二十二根，她是從桶子裡數出來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty two sticks, and nothing else?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti tu stɪks, ænd ˈnʌθɪŋ ɛls?/
dialogue.zh: 二十二串，另外沒有別的了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, plus one fried cake from the next cart.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt, plʌs wʌn fraɪd keɪk frʌm ðə nɛkst kɑrt./
dialogue.zh: 對，還有隔壁那車的一顆炸油餅。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sticks cost ten each here, that is the rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɪks kɔst tɛn itʃ hɪr, ðæt ɪz ðə rul./
dialogue.zh: 這裡的串一律一串十元，這是規矩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten each times twenty two, my head hurts.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn itʃ taɪmz ˈtwɛnti tu, maɪ hɛd hɜrts./
dialogue.zh: 一串十元乘二十二，我頭都要算了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hurts is one word, let me write it down.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɜrts ɪz wʌn wɜrd, lɛt mi raɪt ɪt daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 頭疼歸頭疼，讓我先寫下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the receipt stub, it lies flat there.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ði rɪˈsit stʌb, ɪt laɪz flæt ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 用那張收據尾巴，它攤得很平。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stub found, two hundred twenty for the sticks.
dialogue.phonetic: /stʌb faʊnd, tu ˈhʌndrəd ˈtwɛnti fɔr ðə stɪks./
dialogue.zh: 單子找到了，烤串兩百二十。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Add the drinks, they sit outside the count.
dialogue.phonetic: /æd ðə drɪŋks, ðeɪ sɪt ˌaʊtˈsaɪd ðə kaʊnt./
dialogue.zh: 飲料要另外加，那些沒算在串數裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Count the drinks: two teas and one plum juice.
dialogue.phonetic: /kaʊnt ðə drɪŋks, tu tiz ænd wʌn plʌm dʒus./
dialogue.zh: 數一下飲料，兩杯茶和一杯冬瓜茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Teas are forty each, the juice is sixty.
dialogue.phonetic: /tiz ɑr ˈfɔrti itʃ, ðə dʒus ɪz ˈsɪksti./
dialogue.zh: 茶一杯四十，冬瓜茶六十。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sixty plus eighty is one hundred forty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪksti plʌs ˈeɪti ɪz wʌn ˈhʌndrəd ˈfɔrti./
dialogue.zh: 六十加八十，飲料總共一百四十。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait, you forgot the sugar on the doughnut.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt, ju fərˈɡɑt ðə ˈʃʊɡər ɑn ðə ˈdɔˌnət./
dialogue.zh: 等等，你忘了甜甜圈的糖粉要另算。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Doughnut is tomorrow, tonight only sticks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdɔˌnət ɪz təˈmɑroʊ, təˈnaɪt ˈoʊnli stɪks./
dialogue.zh: 甜甜圈留到明天，今晚只算烤串。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Agreed, so the drinks are one forty.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈɡrid, soʊ ðə drɪŋks ər wʌn ˈfɔrti./
dialogue.zh: 好，那飲料那欄是一百四十。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One forty in drinks, plus sticks, three sixty.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈfɔrti ɪn drɪŋks, plʌs stɪks, θri ˈsɪksti./
dialogue.zh: 飲料一百四十，加烤串就是三百六。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three sixty, the auntie nods without looking.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri ˈsɪksti, ði ˈænti nɑdz wɪˈðaʊt ˈlʊkɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 三百六，阿媽看都不看就點頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Looking is not needed, she hears stick counts.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlʊkɪŋ ɪz nɑt ˈnidɪd, ʃi hɪrz stɪk kaʊnts./
dialogue.zh: 她不用看，光聽就知道幾串。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Counts, yes, and the bucket tells her the rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /kaʊnts, jɛs, ænd ðə ˈbʌkɪt tɛlz hɜr ðə rɛst./
dialogue.zh: 對，剩下的她看桶子就知道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Add the napkin bundle, ten more on top.
dialogue.phonetic: /æd ðə ˈnæpkɪn ˈbʌndəl, tɛn mɔr ɑn tɑp./
dialogue.zh: 那包紙巾也要算，上面再加十元。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten? Those napkins hang there for free.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn? ðoʊz ˈnæpkɪnz hæŋ ðɛr fɔr fri./
dialogue.zh: 十元？那些紙巾掛在旁邊免費拿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Free at the grill, but the sauce cart charges.
dialogue.phonetic: /fri ət ðə ɡrɪl, bʌt ðə sɔs kɑrt ˈtʃɑrdʒɪz./
dialogue.zh: 烤攤那邊免費，那台賣醬的車要收錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The next cart wants thirty for its sauce.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə nɛkst kɑrt wɑnts ˈθɜrti fɔr ɪts sɔs./
dialogue.zh: 下一台車光是醬就要三十。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sauce for thirty, that buys three plain sticks.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɔs fɔr ˈθɜrti, ðə baɪz θri pleɪn stɪks./
dialogue.zh: 醬要三十？那夠買三串原味的了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Money talks, the auntie writes it in ink.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmʌni tɔks, ði ˈænti raɪts ɪt ɪn ɪŋk./
dialogue.zh: 錢最大，阿媽直接用原子筆寫下去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: In ink, no erasing, so check her line.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ɪŋk, noʊ ɪˈreɪzɪŋ, soʊ tʃɛk hɜr laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 用筆寫了就不能塗，檢查她那一行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Her line reads twenty two plus three extras.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɜr laɪn ridz ˈtwɛnti tu plʌs θri ˈɛkstrəz./
dialogue.zh: 她那一行寫二十二串，外加三筆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The extras are drinks, sauce, and the cake.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈɛkstrəz ər drɪŋks, sɔs, ænd ðə keɪk./
dialogue.zh: 三筆是飲料、醬，還有那顆油餅。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Drinks are one forty, sauce adds thirty more.
dialogue.phonetic: /drɪŋks ər wʌn ˈfɔrti, sɔs ædz ˈθɜrti mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 飲料一百四十，醬再加三十。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cart to cart, the receipt grows like a stack.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑrt tə kɑrt, ðə rɪˈsit ɡroʊz laɪk ə stæk./
dialogue.zh: 攤車一輛一輛算，單子疊得好厚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stack it with ours, we pay only once.
dialogue.phonetic: /stæk ɪt wɪð ˈaʊərz, wi peɪ ˈoʊnli wʌns./
dialogue.zh: 把我們的也疊進去，我們一次付清。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Once, and we skip five separate waits.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌns, ænd wi skɪp faɪv ˈsɛpərət weɪts./
dialogue.zh: 一次付清，就省掉五趟等待。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Her rule is one paper covers every cart.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɜr rul ɪz wʌn ˈpeɪpər ˈkʌvərz ˈɛvri kɑrt./
dialogue.zh: 她的規矩是一張單子統收所有攤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then write the whole night in one line.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn raɪt ðə hoʊl naɪt ɪn wʌn laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 那就把整個夜晚寫進一行裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two twenty at the grill, one forty for drinks.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈtwɛnti ət ðə ɡrɪl, wʌn ˈfɔrti fɔr drɪŋks./
dialogue.zh: 烤架兩百二十，飲料那一百四十。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sauce is thirty, then cake and bag twenty.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɔs ɪz ˈθɜrti, ðɛn keɪk ænd bæɡ ˈtwɛnti./
dialogue.zh: 醬三十，油餅加袋子共二十。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five for a bag? They always charge for those.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv fɔr ə bæɡ? ðeɪ ˈɔlˌweɪz tʃɑrdʒ fɔr ðoʊz./
dialogue.zh: 袋子要五元？他們向來都收這個錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bags cost, but we keep them, no returning.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæɡz kɔst, bʌt wi kip ðɛm, noʊ rɪˈtɜrnɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 袋子要錢，但我們自己收著，不退。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Returning is for the metal bucket, not paper.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈtɜrnɪŋ ɪz fɔr ðə ˈmɛtəl ˈbʌkɪt, nɑt ˈpeɪpər./
dialogue.zh: 要退的是鐵桶，不是紙袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Paper, plastic, sticks, it all gets counted.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpeɪpər, ˈplæstɪk, stɪks, ɪt ɔl ɡɛts ˈkaʊntɪd./
dialogue.zh: 紙、塑膠、竹簽，全部都要算。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Counted twice, the auntie trusts her own hands.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkaʊntɪd twaɪs, ði ˈænti trʌsts hɜr oʊn hændz./
dialogue.zh: 數兩遍，阿媽只相信自己雙手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hands are busy, so her eyes do the math.
dialogue.phonetic: /hændz ɑr ˈbɪzi, soʊ hɜr aɪz du ðə mæθ./
dialogue.zh: 她的手忙著翻串，所以用眼睛算。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Math done, she shows us the scrap of paper.
dialogue.phonetic: /mæθ dʌn, ʃi ʃoʊz ʌs ðə skræp əv ˈpeɪpər./
dialogue.zh: 算完了，她把那張碎紙遞給我看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Paper shows four hundred ten, is that right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpeɪpər ʃoʊz fɔr ˈhʌndrəd tɛn, ɪz ðæt raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 紙上寫四百一十，對嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, it holds the sauce and the bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt, ɪt hoʊldz ðə sɔs ænd ðə bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，醬和袋子都在裡面了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sauce costs extra, we should have asked first.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɔs kɔsts ˈɛkstrə, wi ʃʊd əv æskt fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 蘸醬要加錢，我們該先問清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Asked or not, four hundred ten is fair.
dialogue.phonetic: /æskt ɔr nɑt, fɔr ˈhʌndrəd tɛn ɪz fɛr./
dialogue.zh: 問不問都一樣，四百一十算公道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair for sticks, but plenty for one table.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛr fɔr stɪks, bʌt ˈplɛnti fɔr wʌn ˈteɪbəl./
dialogue.zh: 對串來說是公道，但對一桌就是大錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One table, two of us, all on us.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈteɪbəl, tu ʌv ʌs, ɔl ɑn ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 一張桌兩個人，全算在我們頭上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: On us, and the wallet has to cover it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ʌs, ænd ðə ˈwɑlɪt hæz tə ˈkʌvər ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我們付，所以錢包得撐住這筆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four hundred ten in notes, that is a stack.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr ˈhʌndrəd tɛn ɪn noʊts, ðæt ɪz ə stæk./
dialogue.zh: 四百一十的鈔票，疊起來厚厚一疊。
