dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bill or coins, the auntie takes both, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪl ɔr kɔɪnz, ði ˈænti teɪks boʊθ, aɪ θɪŋk./
dialogue.zh: 紙鈔或硬幣都行，我想她都收。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She likes coins because bills get wet here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi laɪks kɔɪnz bɪˈkɔz bɪlz ɡɛt wɛt hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 她愛硬幣，因為紙鈔在這裡會濕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wet bills come from the ice bucket, always.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛt bɪlz kʌm frʌm ðə aɪs ˈbʌkɪt, ˈɔlˌweɪz./
dialogue.zh: 濕掉的鈔票都是從冰桶裡拿出來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Always, so keep your money out of the splash.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlˌweɪz, soʊ kip jʊr ˈmʌni aʊt əv ðə splæʃ./
dialogue.zh: 每次都這樣，所以錢別放在會噴水的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Either way, four hundred ten is what we owe.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɪðər weɪ, fɔr ˈhʌndrəd tɛn ɪz wʌt wi oʊ./
dialogue.zh: 不管怎樣，四百一十都是我們欠的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every cart sits on her one paper, see.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvri kɑrt sɪts ɑn hɜr wʌn ˈpeɪpər, si./
dialogue.zh: 每一攤都在她那張單子上，你看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fifteen for the cake, five for the bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌfɪfˈtin fɔr ðə keɪk, faɪv fɔr ðə bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 油餅十五，袋子五元。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Forks here? The cake comes wrapped in paper.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔrks hɪr? ðə keɪk kʌmz ræpt ɪn ˈpeɪpər./
dialogue.zh: 這裡有叉子？油餅只用紙包著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Forks do not exist here, only bamboo.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔrks du nɑt ɪɡˈzɪst hɪr, ˈoʊnli ˌbæmˈbu./
dialogue.zh: 這種地方沒有叉子，只有竹子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bamboo for everything, even the doughnut box.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌbæmˈbu fɔr ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ, ˈivən ðə ˈdoʊnət bɑks./
dialogue.zh: 什麼都用竹的，連甜甜圈那盒也是。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The doughnut box will need its own small total.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈdoʊnət bɑks wɪl nid ɪts oʊn smɔl ˈtoʊtəl./
dialogue.zh: 甜甜圈那盒要另算一個小總數。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small total, six rings, that is one eighty.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl ˈtoʊtəl, sɪks rɪŋz, ðæt ɪz wʌn ˈeɪti./
dialogue.zh: 小總額就是六個圈，一百八。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One eighty for doughnuts is honestly cheap.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈeɪti fɔr ˈdɔˌnəts ɪz ˈɑnəstli tʃip./
dialogue.zh: 一百八買甜甜圈其實很便宜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cheap now, expensive after the first ring.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃip naʊ, ɪkˈspɛnsɪv ˈæftər ðə fɜrst rɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 買的時候便宜，吃完一個就覺得值。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ring by ring we will test that theory later.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪŋ baɪ rɪŋ wi wɪl tɛst ðæt ˈθɪri ˈleɪtər./
dialogue.zh: 到時候一個一個來驗證這個理論。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Later means the hotel, so buy the small box.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈleɪtər minz ðə hoʊˈtɛl, soʊ baɪ ðə smɔl bɑks./
dialogue.zh: 晚一點就是在旅館吃了，所以買小盒的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Box, bag, receipt, do not lose any piece.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɑks, bæɡ, rɪˈsit, du nɑt luz ˈɛni pis./
dialogue.zh: 盒子、袋子、收據，一樣都不能丟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pieces stay in my jacket pocket, safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpisəz steɪ ɪn maɪ ˈdʒækɪt ˈpɑkɪt, seɪf./
dialogue.zh: 東西都塞進我外套口袋，安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Safe is good, the crowd here steals elbows.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪf ɪz ɡʊd, ðə kraʊd hɪr stilz ˈɛlˌboʊz./
dialogue.zh: 安全就好，這人潮連手肘都會被擠走。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nothing gets stolen, just crumpled bills.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌθɪŋ ɡɛts ˈstoʊlənd, dʒʌst ˈkrʌmpəld bɪlz./
dialogue.zh: 沒什麼被偷，只有鈔票被擠皺了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Crumpled is fine, the auntie smooths it twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkrʌmpəld ɪz faɪn, ði ˈænti smuðz ɪt twaɪs./
dialogue.zh: 皺了沒關係，阿媽會把它抹平兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twice, then folds it into her apron pocket.
dialogue.phonetic: /twaɪs, ðɛn foʊldz ɪt ˈɪntu hɜr ˈeɪprən ˈpɑkɪt./
dialogue.zh: 抹平之後再摺進圍裙口袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pocket full of scraps, that apron is a bank.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɑkɪt fʊl əv skræps, ðæt ˈeɪprən ɪz ə bæŋk./
dialogue.zh: 口袋塞滿單子，那條圍裙根本就是銀行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A bank that never closes, only empties at midnight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə bæŋk ðæt ˈnɛvər ˈkloʊzəz, ˈoʊnli ˈɛmptiz æt ˈmaɪdˌnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 一家從不關門的銀行，只在午夜清空。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Late night empties the bucket and the tray.
dialogue.phonetic: /leɪt naɪt ˈɛmptiz ðə ˈbʌkɪt ænd ðə treɪ./
dialogue.zh: 夜深了，竹簽桶和托盤都空了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tray empty, sticks gone, and our bill is clear.
dialogue.phonetic: /treɪ ˈɛmpti, stɪks ɡɔn, ænd ˈaʊər bɪl ɪz klɪr./
dialogue.zh: 托盤空了、串也沒了，我們的帳也清了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Clear the bill, then we free this shared bench.
dialogue.phonetic: /klɪr ðə bɪl, ðɛn wi fri ðɪs ʃɛrd bɛntʃ./
dialogue.zh: 帳結了，我們就讓出這張共用椅。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Free it fast, a new group waits with stools.
dialogue.phonetic: /fri ɪt fæst, ə nu ɡrup weɪts wɪð stulz./
dialogue.zh: 趕快騰出來，新一群人抬著椅子在等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: With stools or not, we owe them that corner.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪð stulz ɔr nɑt, wi oʊ ðɛm ðæt ˈkɔrnər./
dialogue.zh: 不管他們有沒有椅子，那個角落都該留給了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Owe them a thank you and the table wipe.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðɛm ə θæŋk ju ænd ði ˈteɪbəl waɪp./
dialogue.zh: 欠他們一句謝謝，還有擦乾淨的桌面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wipe it, and the auntie will nod at us.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪp ɪt, ænd ði ˈænti wɪl nɑd æt ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 把桌子擦一擦，阿媽會對我們點頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nod means we are welcome back tomorrow night.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑd minz wi ɑr ˈwɛlkəm bæk təˈmɑroʊ naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 點頭代表明晚還歡迎我們來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tomorrow night we want ten sticks again.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈmɑroʊ naɪt wi wɑnt tɛn stɪks əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 明晚我們想再來吃十串。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Again, and this time we count while he writes.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈɡɛn, ænd ðɪs taɪm wi kaʊnt waɪl hi raɪts./
dialogue.zh: 還要，這次邊寫邊跟他們數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Writes it down, then reads the sum out loud.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪts ɪt daʊn, ðɛn ridz ðə sʌm aʊt laʊd./
dialogue.zh: 他寫下來，然後把總數大聲念。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Loud enough, four hundred ten on the paper.
dialogue.phonetic: /laʊd ɪˈnʌf, fɔr ˈhʌndrəd tɛn ɑn ðə ˈpeɪpər./
dialogue.zh: 聲音夠大了，四百一十寫在單子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly four hundred ten, and twenty two sticks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli fɔr ˈhʌndrəd tɛn, ænd ˈtwɛnti tu stɪks./
dialogue.zh: 正好四百一十，串是二十二根。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty two is plenty when the smoke is good.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti tu ɪz ˈplɛnti wɛn ðə smoʊk ɪz ɡʊd./
dialogue.zh: 煙味夠好的話，二十二串已經很多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good smoke, cheap sticks, the math works out.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd smoʊk, tʃip stɪks, ðə mæθ wɜrks aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 煙好、串便宜，這筆帳怎麼算都划算。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Works out better than the mall food court prices.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɜrks aʊt ˈbɛtər ðæn ðə mɔl fud kɔrt ˈpraɪsəz./
dialogue.zh: 比商場美食街的價格漂亮多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Prices aside, how do we split the bill?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpraɪsəz əˈsaɪd, haʊ du wi splɪt ðə bɪl?/
dialogue.zh: 價格先不講，我們怎麼分這筆錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half, plus two sticks for being late.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf, plʌs tu stɪks fɔr ˈbiɪŋ leɪt./
dialogue.zh: 一半，再外加兩串罰你遲到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair, here is my half in crisp notes.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛr, hɪr ɪz maɪ hæf ɪn krɪsp noʊts./
dialogue.zh: 應該的，我這半用平整的鈔票付。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Crisp notes make the auntie smile every time.
dialogue.phonetic: /krɪsp noʊts meɪk ði ˈænti smaɪl ˈɛvri taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 新鈔每次都會讓阿媽笑一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Every time, and she never needs a calculator.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvri taɪm, ænd ʃi ˈnɛvər nidz ə ˈkælkjəˌletər./
dialogue.zh: 每一次都是，她從不需要計算機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Calculator? Her fingers are faster than mine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkælkjəˌletər? hɜr ˈfɪŋɡərz ɑr ˈfæstər ðæn maɪn./
dialogue.zh: 計算機？她的手指比我的快多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine stopped working at two hundred eighty.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn stɑpt ˈwɜrkɪŋ æt tu ˈhʌndrəd ˈeɪti./
dialogue.zh: 我的手指算到兩百八十就不聽使了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eighty is where I always lose the thread.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈeɪti ɪz wɛr aɪ ˈɔlˌweɪz luz ðə θrɛd./
dialogue.zh: 一到八十我就會忘記算到哪裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My wallet holds only sixty in cash.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈwɑlɪt hoʊldz ˈoʊnli ˈsɪksti ɪn kæʃ./
dialogue.zh: 我的錢包裡的現金只剩六十。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sixty? The bill came to four hundred ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪksti? ðə bɪl keɪm tə fɔr ˈhʌndrəd tɛn./
dialogue.zh: 六十？帳單可是算到四百一十。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four hundred ten, and my pocket has sixty.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr ˈhʌndrəd tɛn, ænd maɪ ˈpɑkɪt hæz ˈsɪksti./
dialogue.zh: 四百一十，可我口袋只有六十。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only sixty means we must find another way.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ˈsɪksti minz wi mʌst faɪnd əˈnʌðər weɪ./
dialogue.zh: 只有六十就表示得想別的辦法。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Check your other pocket, the small one.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛk jʊr ˈʌðər ˈpɑkɪt, ðə smɔl wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 檢查你另一個口袋，小那個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small pocket has two lint balls and a stick.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl ˈpɑkɪt hæz tu lɪnt bɔlz ænd ə stɪk./
dialogue.zh: 小口袋只有兩團棉絮和一根竹簽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A stick is not money, though it feels close.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə stɪk ɪz nɑt ˈmʌni, ðoʊ ɪt filz kloʊs./
dialogue.zh: 竹簽不是錢，雖然拿了一整天很有錯覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: True, the grill man wants real bills tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /tru, ðə ɡrɪl mæn wɑnts ril bɪlz təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 也是，今晚烤架大哥只收真正的鈔票。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Real bills? The auntie points at a sticker.
dialogue.phonetic: /ril bɪlz? ði ˈænti pɔɪnts æt ə ˈstɪkər./
dialogue.zh: 一定要鈔票？阿媽卻指了一張貼紙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The sticker on her cart takes phone payments.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈstɪkər ɑn hɜr kɑrt teɪks foʊn ˈpeɪmənts./
dialogue.zh: 她攤車上那張貼紙是可以行動支付的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Phone payments, my screen is at two percent.
dialogue.phonetic: /foʊn ˈpeɪmənts, maɪ skrin ɪz æt tu pərˈsɛnt./
dialogue.zh: 行動支付，可我手機只剩百分之二的電。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two percent still scans, hold it steady there.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu pərˈsɛnt stɪl skænz, hoʊld ɪt ˈstɛdi ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 百分之二也掃得出去，拿穩一點對著掃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Scanning now, the little circle just spins.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈskænɪŋ naʊ, ðə ˈlɪtəl ˈsɜrkəl dʒʌst spɪnz./
dialogue.zh: 正在掃，那個小圓圈一直轉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That circle means no signal, the tents eat it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈsɜrkəl minz noʊ ˈsɪɡnəl, ðə tɛnts it ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 那圈代表沒訊號，帳棚把訊號吃掉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No bars, no payment, what a night.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ bɑrz, noʊ ˈpeɪmənt, wʌt ə naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 沒訊號就付不了錢，這什麼夜晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A night like this needs a plan for cash.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə naɪt laɪk ðɪs nidz ə plæn fɔr kæʃ./
dialogue.zh: 這種晚上就是要先準備現金的計畫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cash machine? There is one by the temple gate.
dialogue.phonetic: /kæʃ məˈʃin? ðɛr ɪz wʌn baɪ ðə ˈtɛmpəl ɡeɪt./
dialogue.zh: 提款機？廟口那邊就有一台。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one swallows cards, mine came back bent.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌn səˈloʊz kɑrdz, maɪn keɪm bæk bɛnt./
dialogue.zh: 那台會吃卡，我那張退出來的時候是彎的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bent card, good story, but we need paper money.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɛnt kɑrd, ɡʊd ˈstɔri, bʌt wi nid ˈpeɪpər ˈmʌni./
dialogue.zh: 彎掉的卡算一個好故事，但我們要紙鈔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Paper money lives in your bag, front pocket.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpeɪpər ˈmʌni lɪvz ɪn jʊr bæɡ, frʌnt ˈpɑkɪt./
dialogue.zh: 紙鈔就在你那個包的前夾層。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Front pocket has the two hundred I keep hidden.
dialogue.phonetic: /frʌnt ˈpɑkɪt hæz ðə tu ˈhʌndrəd aɪ kip ˈhɪdən./
dialogue.zh: 前夾層確實有我先藏起來的兩百。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hidden money buys the sticks, come on, dig.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɪdən ˈmʌni baɪz ðə stɪks, kʌm ɑn, dɪɡ./
dialogue.zh: 藏起來的錢也能買串，快掏出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dig it out, the auntie waits with the tray.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪɡ ɪt aʊt, ði ˈænti weɪts wɪð ðə treɪ./
dialogue.zh: 我把它挖出來，阿媽端著托盤在等。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tray is heavy, hurry, the line grows behind us.
dialogue.phonetic: /treɪ ɪz ˈhɛvi, ˈhɜri, ðə laɪn ɡroʊz bɪˈhaɪnd ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 托盤很重，快一點，我們後面又排長了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Behind us, a man holds twenty sticks already.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪˈhaɪnd ʌs, ə mæn hoʊldz ˈtwɛnti stɪks ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 後面那個人已經拿了二十串。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Locals never queue, they just call the auntie.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈloʊkəlz ˈnɛvər kju, ðeɪ dʒʌst kɔl ði ˈænti./
dialogue.zh: 在地人都不排隊，他們直接喊阿媽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Call her and we owe a tip, maybe.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔl hɜr ænd wi oʊ ə tɪp, ˈmeɪbi./
dialogue.zh: 喊她的話我們大概就得給點小費。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tips are for guides, here extra skewers count.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɪps ɑr fɔr ɡaɪdz, hɪr ˈɛkstrə ˈskjʊrz kaʊnt./
dialogue.zh: 小費是給導遊的，這裡是多送兩串比較實在。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two hundred plus sixty, that is two hundred sixty.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈhʌndrəd plʌs ˈsɪksti, ðæt ɪz tu ˈhʌndrəd ˈsɪksti./
dialogue.zh: 跟我算，兩百加六十是兩百六十。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So we are short a hundred fifty right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wi ɑr ʃɔrt ə ˈhʌndrəd ˈfɪfti raɪt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 所以我們現在差一百五十。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right now? The grill man keeps flipping sticks.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt naʊ? ðə ɡrɪl mæn kips ˈflɪpɪŋ stɪks./
dialogue.zh: 就現在？烤架那個人一直在翻串。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Flipping means ours are coming, pay him first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈflɪpɪŋ minz ˈaʊərz ɑr ˈkʌmɪŋ, peɪ hɪm fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 翻串就是我們的要出爐了，先付錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First part, ask him if he splits payments.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrst pɑrt, æsk hɪm ɪf hi splɪts ˈpeɪmənts./
dialogue.zh: 第一件事，問他能不能拆著付。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Payments split? He shrugs and points at the code.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpeɪmənts splɪt? hi ʃrʌɡz ænd pɔɪnts æt ðə koʊd./
dialogue.zh: 拆著付？他聳肩，指了指那個支付條碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The code on his apron, the phone is dead.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə koʊd ɑn hɪz əˈprɑn, ðə foʊn ɪz dɛd./
dialogue.zh: 條碼貼在他圍裙上，但我手機已經黑了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dead phone means cash only, dig again.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɛd foʊn minz kæʃ ˈoʊnli, dɪɡ əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 手機掛了就只收現金，再翻一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Again? I emptied both pockets on the bench.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈɡɛn? aɪ ˈɛmptid boʊθ ˈpɑkɪts ɑn ðə bɛntʃ./
dialogue.zh: 還翻？我兩個口袋早清空在長椅上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both pockets, yes, mine holds only coins.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ ˈpɑkɪts, jɛs, maɪn hoʊldz ˈoʊnli kɔɪnz./
dialogue.zh: 兩個口袋都在，我這邊只有銅板。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Coins pile high here, nobody wants them.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔɪnz paɪl haɪ hɪr, ˈnoʊbədi wɑnts ðɛm./
dialogue.zh: 零錢在我們手上堆很高，可是沒人想收。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The auntie likes crisp notes, not these coins.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈænti laɪks krɪsp noʊts, nɑt ðiz kɔɪnz./
dialogue.zh: 阿媽喜歡平整的鈔票，不是這堆銅板。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Crisp notes are in the hotel, safe and far.
dialogue.phonetic: /krɪsp noʊts ɑr ɪn ðə hoʊˈtɛl, seɪf ænd fɑr./
dialogue.zh: 像樣的鈔票都在旅館裡，安全但很遠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Far means we walk back with empty hands.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɑr minz wi wɔk bæk wɪð ˈɛmpti hændz./
dialogue.zh: 遠就代表我們得空手走回去拿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Empty hands cannot carry a bag of sticks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛmpti hændz ˈkænɑt ˈkæri ə bæɡ əv stɪks./
dialogue.zh: 空手怎麼提得住一袋烤串。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sticks can wait, the grill stays open late.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɪks kæn weɪt, ðə ɡrɪl steɪz ˈoʊpən leɪt./
dialogue.zh: 串會等我們，烤架本來就開很晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Open late, so let the auntie keep our plate.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊpən leɪt, soʊ lɛt ði ˈænti kip ˈaʊər pleɪt./
dialogue.zh: 既然開得晚，就請阿媽先收著我們的盤子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She will mark our names right on the ticket.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi wɪl mɑrk ˈaʊər neɪmz raɪt ɑn ðə ˈtɪkɪt./
dialogue.zh: 她會把我們的名字直接寫在單上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ticket marked, now who runs to the machine?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtɪkɪt mɑrkt, naʊ hu rʌnz tə ðə məˈʃin./
dialogue.zh: 單子寫好了，誰跑去提款機？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Runs means you, take your card and hope.
dialogue.phonetic: /rʌnz minz ju, teɪk jʊr kɑrd ænd hoʊp./
dialogue.zh: 跑的該是你，帶著你的卡去賭一把。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hope the temple gate machine takes this card.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊp ðə ˈtɛmpəl ɡeɪt məˈʃin teɪks ðɪs kɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 希望廟口那台肯收這張卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Card or not, come back with a hundred fifty.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑrd ɔr nɑt, kʌm bæk wɪð ə ˈhʌndrəd ˈfɪfti./
dialogue.zh: 卡能用不能用都隨便，反正帶一百五十回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fifty times three, I will be quick, I promise.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɪfti taɪmz θri, aɪ wɪl bi kwɪk, aɪ ˈprɑmɪs./
dialogue.zh: 五十的三倍，我會很快，我保證。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Promise kept, I hold the bag and the tickets.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈprɑmɪs kɛpt, aɪ hoʊld ðə bæɡ ænd ðə ˈtɪkɪts./
dialogue.zh: 承諾我先收，我看著袋子和號碼牌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tickets plus bag, guard them with your life.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtɪkɪts plʌs bæɡ, ɡɑrd ðɛm wɪð jʊr laɪf./
dialogue.zh: 牌子和袋子都交給你看命守著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My life, the bag, and one warm skewer stack.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ laɪf, ðə bæɡ, ænd wʌn wɔrm ˈskjʊr stæk./
dialogue.zh: 我的命、袋子，還有那一疊熱烤串。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stack stays warm ten minutes, no longer.
dialogue.phonetic: /stæk steɪz wɔrm tɛn ˈmɪnɪts, noʊ ˈlɔŋɡər./
dialogue.zh: 那疊串只保溫十分鐘，更久就沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten minutes, so run, the crossing is ahead.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ˈmɪnɪts, soʊ rʌn, ðə ˈkrɔsɪŋ ɪz əˈhɛd./
dialogue.zh: 十分鐘那就快跑，斑馬線就在前面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ahead past the fruit cart, then left at lamps.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈhɛd pæst ðə frut kɑrt, ðɛn lɛft æt læmpz./
dialogue.zh: 過了水果車，看到路燈就往左。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lamps? The temple gate has six, you cannot miss.
dialogue.phonetic: /læmpz? ðə ˈtɛmpəl ɡeɪt hæz sɪks, ju ˈkænɑt mɪs./
dialogue.zh: 路燈？廟口有六盞，你不可能錯過。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cannot miss it, the light blinks green all night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkænɑt mɪs ɪt, ðə laɪt blɪŋks ɡrin ɔl naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 不會錯過的，那盞燈整夜閃綠光。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Green blink means busy, stand back and wait.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡrin blɪŋk minz ˈbɪzi, stænd bæk ænd weɪt./
dialogue.zh: 綠燈閃代表機器忙碌，退一步等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Busy machine, I will ask the security man.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɪzi məˈʃin, aɪ wɪl æsk ðə sɪˈkjʊrəti mæn./
dialogue.zh: 機器正忙，我過去問一下保全。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Security man? Here the aunties guard the tables.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪˈkjʊrəti mæn? hɪr ði ˈæntiz ɡɑrd ðə ˈteɪbəlz./
dialogue.zh: 保全？這區看桌子的是阿媽們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tables guarded, cash not found, we are stuck.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈteɪbəlz ˈɡɑrdəd, kæʃ nɑt faʊnd, wi ɑr stʌk./
dialogue.zh: 桌子有人顧，現金找不到，我們卡住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stuck is fine, the grill man trusts our names.
dialogue.phonetic: /stʌk ɪz faɪn, ðə ɡrɪl mæn trʌsts ˈaʊər neɪmz./
dialogue.zh: 卡住也沒關係，烤架大哥信我們的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Trusts our names, he said we can come back.
dialogue.phonetic: /trʌsts ˈaʊər neɪmz, hi sɛd wi kæn kʌm bæk./
dialogue.zh: 他信我們的名字，還說我們可以再回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Back after nine, when the corner thins out.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæk ˈæftər naɪn, wɛn ðə ˈkɔrnər θɪnz aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 九點以後再回來，那個路口會變空。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Debt at a night market, I never planned that.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɛt æt ə naɪt ˈmɑrkɪt, aɪ ˈnɛvər plænd ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 在夜市欠帳，我從來沒這樣安排過。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Planned or not, write the number on your hand.
dialogue.phonetic: /plænd ɔr nɑt, raɪt ðə ˈnʌmbər ɑn jʊr hænd./
dialogue.zh: 規不規畫都一樣，把數字寫在你手上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your hand already has chili grease on it.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr hænd ɔlˈrɛdi hæz ˈtʃɪli ɡris ɑn ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 你手上早就全是辣椒油了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then write on the ticket, it stays dry there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn raɪt ɑn ðə ˈtɪkɪt, ɪt steɪz draɪ ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 那就寫在單子上，那個地方是乾的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There, done, four ten with our two names.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr, dʌn, fɔr tɛn wɪð ˈaʊər tu neɪmz./
dialogue.zh: 寫好了，四百一，還有我們兩個名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Names on paper beats a dead phone any night.
dialogue.phonetic: /neɪmz ɑn ˈpeɪpər bits ə dɛd foʊn ˈɛni naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 紙上的名字勝過一支沒電的手機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any night, and the stall light stays on late.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni naɪt, ænd ðə stɔl laɪt steɪz ɑn leɪt./
dialogue.zh: 每一晚都是，攤子的燈也一直亮到晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Late means the owner counts the box alone.
dialogue.phonetic: /leɪt minz ði ˈoʊnər kaʊnts ðə bɑks əˈloʊn./
dialogue.zh: 晚了老闆就獨自一個數錢箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Alone, with a metal box and a calculator.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈloʊn wɪð ə ˈmɛtəl bɑks ænd ə ˈkælkjəˌletər./
dialogue.zh: 一個人，配一個鐵錢箱和一台計算機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Calculator for a skewer cart, the world changed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkælkjəˌletər fɔr ə ˈskjʊr kɑrt, ðə wɜrld tʃeɪndʒd./
dialogue.zh: 烤串車也用計算機了，世界變了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Changed, but the auntie still writes by hand.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃeɪndʒd, bʌt ði ˈænti stɪl raɪts baɪ hænd./
dialogue.zh: 變是變了，阿媽還是用寫的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Her hand knows every stick count without looking.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɜr hænd noʊz ˈɛvri stɪk kaʊnt wɪˈðaʊt ˈlʊkɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 她的手不用看就知道數了幾串。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Without looking she still wants the real money.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪˈðaʊt ˈlʊkɪŋ ʃi stɪl wɑnts ðə ril ˈmʌni./
dialogue.zh: 她不看也要真正的錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Real money sits in the temple gate machine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ril ˈmʌni sɪts ɪn ðə ˈtɛmpəl ɡeɪt məˈʃin./
dialogue.zh: 真正的錢還在廟口那台機器裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It kept the card, the machine gave receipts.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt kɛpt ðə kɑrd, ðə məˈʃin ɡeɪv rɪˈsits./
dialogue.zh: 機器吞了那張卡，只吐出一張收據。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Receipts do not grill lamb, we need cash now.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈsits du nɑt ɡrɪl læm, wi nid kæʃ naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 收據不能烤羊肉，我們現在要現金。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now, or the next stall takes us by card.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ, ɔr ðə nɛkst stɔl teɪks ʌs baɪ kɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 就是現在，不然是隔壁攤會刷卡收我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The juice cart takes cards, go there first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə dʒus kɑrt teɪks kɑrdz, ɡoʊ ðɛr fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 冬瓜茶那台可以刷卡，先去那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pay there, clear her paper, that is the plan.
dialogue.phonetic: /peɪ ðɛr, klɪr hɜr ˈpeɪpər, ðæt ɪz ðə plæn./
dialogue.zh: 在那邊刷，把她那張單子結清，就這麼辦。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My card works if it beeps one time.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ kɑrd wɜrks ɪf ɪt bits wʌn taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 我的卡能用，只要嗶一聲就通。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One beep, one payment, one less worry tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn bip, wʌn ˈpeɪmənt, wʌn lɛs ˈwɜri təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 嗶一聲、付一筆、今晚少煩一件事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Worry less, but keep some cash for the taxi.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɜri lɛs, bʌt kip sʌm kæʃ fɔr ðə ˈtæksi./
dialogue.zh: 少煩一點，但要留現金搭計程車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The taxi here wants coins, not the phone app.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈtæksi hɪr wɑnts kɔɪnz, nɑt ðə foʊn æp./
dialogue.zh: 這邊的計程車要銅板，不要手機支付。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: App money stays for the doughnut, agreed.
dialogue.phonetic: /æp ˈmʌni steɪz fɔr ðə ˈdɔˌnət, əˈɡrid./
dialogue.zh: 手機裡的錢留給甜甜圈，說定了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Doughnut money is ours, do not touch it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdɔˌnət ˈmʌni ɪz ˈaʊərz, du nɑt tʌtʃ ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 甜甜圈的錢是我們自己的，別動它。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hands off, he brings our sticks to the table.
dialogue.phonetic: /hændz ɔf, hi brɪŋz ˈaʊər stɪks tə ðə ˈteɪbəl./
dialogue.zh: 手別動，他把我們的串端到桌上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: To the table, paid in full, finally relax.
dialogue.phonetic: /tə ðə ˈteɪbəl, peɪd ɪn fʊl, ˈfaɪnəli rɪˈlæks./
dialogue.zh: 端到桌上、付清了，終於可以鬆一口氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Relax now, tomorrow you bring the wallet out.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈlæks naʊ, təˈmɑroʊ ju brɪŋ ðə ˈwɑlɪt aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 現在先放鬆，明天你再把錢包帶出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Out early, before the first stall fires up.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊt ˈɜrli, bɪˈfɔr ðə fɜrst stɔl ˈfaɪərz ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 一早出門，在第一攤生火之前。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At six thirty, the smoke will already greet us.
dialogue.phonetic: /æt sɪks ˈθɜrti, ðə smoʊk wɪl ɔlˈrɛdi ɡrit ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 六點半，煙就會先在路口跟我們打招呼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two sticks each, that is the whole deal.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu stɪks itʃ, ðæt ɪz ðə hoʊl dil./
dialogue.zh: 一人兩串，這就是全部條件。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deal sealed, put your dead phone back away.
dialogue.phonetic: /dil sild, pʊt jʊr dɛd foʊn bæk əˈweɪ./
dialogue.zh: 成交，把手機收起來吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Away from smoke, the paper stays readable.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈweɪ frʌm smoʊk, ðə ˈpeɪpər steɪz ˈridəbəl./
dialogue.zh: 離煙遠一點，單子才看得清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Readable and paid, that is a night market win.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈridəbəl ænd peɪd, ðæt ɪz ə naɪt ˈmɑrkɪt wɪn./
dialogue.zh: 看得清楚又付清了，這在夜市就算贏了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you smell that fried sugar?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju smɛl ðæt fraɪd ˈʃʊɡər?/
dialogue.zh: 你聞到那股炸糖的香味了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the doughnut stall is still open.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə ˈdoʊnət stɔl ɪz stɪl ˈoʊpən./
dialogue.zh: 有啊，甜甜圈攤子還亮著燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We promised no sweets after sticks.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi pɹəˈmɪst noʊ swits ˈæftər stɪks./
dialogue.zh: 我們說過吃完烤串就不吃甜的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We promised twice, and we lied twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi pɹəˈmɪst twaɪs ænd wi laɪd twaɪs./
dialogue.zh: 我們說了兩遍，也撒了兩次謊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stop walking, that fryer is my friend.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɑp ˈwɔkɪŋ ðæt ˈfraɪər ɪz maɪ frɛnd./
dialogue.zh: 別往前走了，那台油炸鍋是我朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your friend charges us for kindness.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr frɛnd ˈtʃɑrdʒɪz ʌs fɔr ˈkaɪndnəs./
dialogue.zh: 你這位朋友，做好事也是要收錢的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many rings in one small box?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni rɪŋz ɪn wʌn smɔl bɑks?/
dialogue.zh: 一小盒裝幾個甜甜圈？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six rings, and eight in the big box.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks rɪŋz ænd eɪt ɪn ðə bɪɡ bɑks./
dialogue.zh: 小盒六個，大盒八個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are those plain, or filled with bean?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðoʊz pleɪn ɔr fɪld wɪθ bin?/
dialogue.zh: 那些是原味的，還是夾紅豆的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The pale ones take red bean paste.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə peɪl wʌnz teɪk rɛd bin peɪst./
dialogue.zh: 顏色淡的那幾個包紅豆餡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are these still hot from the pan?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðiz stɪl hɑt frʌm ðə pæn?/
dialogue.zh: 這些還燙嗎，是剛下鍋的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Out of the oil, wait one minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊt ʌv ðə ɔɪl weɪt wʌn ˈmɪnɪt./
dialogue.zh: 剛離油，再等一分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I want sugar powder on top.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɑnt ˈʃʊɡər ˈpaʊdər ɑn tɑp./
dialogue.zh: 我要表面撒糖粉的那一種。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Powder goes on, sauce stays inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpaʊdər ɡoʊz ɑn sɔs steɪz ɪnˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 糖粉撒外面，餡留在裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which one did the auntie fry last?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ wʌn dɪd ði ˈænti fraɪ læst?/
dialogue.zh: 阿嬤最後炸起來的是哪一排？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The back row, closest to the heat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bæk roʊ ˈkloʊsɪst tu ðə hit./
dialogue.zh: 後面那一排，最靠近火的那個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six rings, no extras, that is us.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks rɪŋz noʊ ˈɛkstrəz ðæt ɪz ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 六個，不加別的，就是我們這一盒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two now, the rest for the hotel room.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu naʊ, ðə rɛst fɔr ðə hoʊˈtɛl rum./
dialogue.zh: 現在吃兩個，其餘留回旅館房間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we need a box or a bag?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi nid ə bɑks ɔr ə bæɡ?/
dialogue.zh: 我們要用盒子裝，還是用袋子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Box first, then one bag for carrying.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɑks fɜrst ðɛn wʌn bæɡ fɔr ˈkæriɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 先裝進盒子，再拿一個提袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep the bag flat, not folded.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ðə bæɡ flæt nɑt ˈfoʊldɪd./
dialogue.zh: 袋子要攤平，不要摺起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A folded bag squashes the sugar.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈfoʊldɪd bæɡ ˈskwɑʃɪz ðə ˈʃʊɡər./
dialogue.zh: 摺過的袋子會壓壞糖粉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One ring looks cracked at the edge.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn rɪŋ lʊks krækt æt ði ɛdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 有一個邊緣看起來裂開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Swap it, the auntie will not mind.
dialogue.phonetic: /swɑp ɪt ðə ˈænti wɪl nɑt maɪnd./
dialogue.zh: 換一個吧，阿嬤不會在意。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She counted six into the box.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi ˈkaʊntɪd sɪks ˈɪntu ðə bɑks./
dialogue.zh: 她數了六個進盒子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She added a seventh on the side.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi ˈædɪd ə ˈsɛvənθ ɑn ðə saɪd./
dialogue.zh: 她還在旁邊多塞了一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that seventh free or paid?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt ˈsɛvənθ fri ɔr peɪd?/
dialogue.zh: 那第七個是送的，還是要算錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Free, she says, for two new faces.
dialogue.phonetic: /fri ʃi sɛz fɔr tu nu ˈfeɪsɪz./
dialogue.zh: 送的，她說給兩位生面孔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now we owe her a good review.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ wi oʊ hɜr ə ɡʊd rɪˈvju./
dialogue.zh: 現在我們欠她一句好評。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Words only, our cash is finished.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɜrdz ˈoʊnli ˈaʊər kæʃ ɪz ˈfɪnɪʃt./
dialogue.zh: 只能用嘴巴誇，現金早用完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your phone works, so the app pays now.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr foʊn wɜrks, soʊ ði æp peɪz naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 你的手機還能用，就用行動支付付帳。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Saved and spent, right at this stall.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪvd ænd spɛnt raɪt æt ðɪs stɔl./
dialogue.zh: 留了又花掉，就在這一個攤子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Scan here, the sticker is peeling off.
dialogue.phonetic: /skæn hɪr ðə ˈstɪkər ɪz ˈpilɪŋ ɔf./
dialogue.zh: 掃這裡，碼的邊角已經翹起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It still reads, do not worry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt stɪl ridz du nɑt ˈwɜri./
dialogue.zh: 還掃得起來，別擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did that payment take, or is it stuck?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ðæt ˈpeɪmənt teɪk ɔr ɪz ɪt stʌk?/
dialogue.zh: 那筆付款過去了嗎，還是卡住？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It took, look at the green check.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt tʊk lʊk æt ðə ɡrin tʃɛk./
dialogue.zh: 過去了，看那個綠色的勾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Receipt is not needed at a stall.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈsit ɪz nɑt ˈnidɪd æt ə stɔl./
dialogue.zh: 攤子這邊不需要收據。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The box itself is our receipt.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɑks ɪtˈsɛlf ɪz ˈaʊər rɪˈsit./
dialogue.zh: 這一盒就是我們的收據。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Give me the bag, your arms are full.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɪv mi ðə bæɡ jʊr ɑrmz ɑr fʊl./
dialogue.zh: 給我袋子吧，你兩手都滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Full is fine, the box is light.
dialogue.phonetic: /fʊl ɪz faɪn ðə bɑks ɪz laɪt./
dialogue.zh: 滿了沒關係，盒子很輕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Warm through the paper, that is good.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm θru ðə ˈpeɪpər ðæt ɪz ɡʊd./
dialogue.zh: 紙袋都被燙熱了，這很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Warm means fresh, cold means yesterday.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm minz frɛʃ, koʊld minz ˈjɛstərdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 燙的才新鮮，冷的是昨天的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One ring sits loose on the counter.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn rɪŋ sɪts lus ɑn ðə ˈkaʊntər./
dialogue.zh: 台子上還鬆鬆放著一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leave it, the cat gets the loose ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /liv ɪt ðə kæt ɡɛts ðə lus wʌnz./
dialogue.zh: 留著吧，掉出來的都歸那隻貓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did we agree on six rings?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd wi əˈɡri ɑn sɪks rɪŋz?/
dialogue.zh: 我們說好要六個了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We agreed on six, she gave seven.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi əˈɡrid ɑn sɪks ʃi ɡeɪv ˈsɛvən./
dialogue.zh: 說好六個，她給了七個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sugar on your sleeve, wipe it off.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʃʊɡər ɑn jʊr sliv waɪp ɪt ɔf./
dialogue.zh: 你袖子上有糖粉，擦掉吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleeve is ruined, ring is safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /sliv ɪz ˈruɪnd rɪŋ ɪz seɪf./
dialogue.zh: 袖子壞了，甜甜圈沒事就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eat it here or save the rest?
dialogue.phonetic: /it ɪt hɪr ɔr seɪv ðə rɛst?/
dialogue.zh: 現在吃，還是留著之後吃？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here is messy, take the rest home.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪz ˈmɛsi teɪk ðə rɛst hoʊm./
dialogue.zh: 現在吃會掉一地，剩下的帶回去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two rings gone before the next stall.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu rɪŋz ɡɔn bɪˈfɔr ðə nɛkst stɔl./
dialogue.zh: 才走到下一個攤子，就吃了兩個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slow down, the line of stalls is long.
dialogue.phonetic: /sloʊ daʊn ðə laɪn ʌv stɔlz ɪz lɔŋ./
dialogue.zh: 慢一點，整排攤子還長得很。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My fingers are sticky from the glaze.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈfɪŋɡərz ɑr ˈstɪki frʌm ðə ɡleɪz./
dialogue.zh: 我手指被糖霜黏住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Napkin in the bag, take one out.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnæpkɪn ɪn ðə bæɡ teɪk wʌn aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 袋子裡有紙巾，抽一張出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is a napkin free at this stall?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ə ˈnæpkɪn fri æt ðɪs stɔl?/
dialogue.zh: 這家攤子的紙巾是免費的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Free napkins, paid doughnuts, fair trade.
dialogue.phonetic: /fri ˈnæpkɪnz peɪd ˈdoʊnəts fɛr treɪd./
dialogue.zh: 紙巾免費，甜甜圈收錢，很公道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we still have app money left?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi stɪl hæv æp ˈmʌni lɛft?/
dialogue.zh: 手機裡還剩錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Left, but only for tomorrow morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛft bʌt ˈoʊnli fɔr təˈmɑroʊ ˈmɔrnɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 還剩，只留給明天早上的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tomorrow morning needs its own budget.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈmɑroʊ ˈmɔrnɪŋ nidz ɪts oʊn ˈbʌdʒɪt./
dialogue.zh: 明天早上也要有自己的預算。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Budget done, we are buying one coffee.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbʌdʒɪt dʌn wi ɑr ˈbaɪjɪŋ wʌn ˈkɔfi./
dialogue.zh: 預算算好了，只夠一杯咖啡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Close the box, the sugar stays better.
dialogue.phonetic: /kloʊz ðə bɑks ðə ˈʃʊɡər steɪz ˈbɛtər./
dialogue.zh: 把盒子蓋上，糖粉比較不會掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better closed now, worse open later.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɛtər kloʊzd naʊ wɜrs ˈoʊpən ˈleɪtər./
dialogue.zh: 現在蓋好最省事，敞著最糟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The auntie wrapped each ring apart.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈænti ræpt itʃ rɪŋ əˈpɑrt./
dialogue.zh: 阿嬤把每個甜甜圈分開包。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Apart keeps the powder on the top.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈpɑrt kips ðə ˈpaʊdər ɑn ðə tɑp./
dialogue.zh: 分開包，糖粉才會留在上面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She uses paper cups, not plastic trays.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi ˈjuzɪz ˈpeɪpər kʌps nɑt ˈplæstɪk treɪz./
dialogue.zh: 她用紙杯，不用塑膠托盤。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cups stack, trays slide off the arm.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʌps stæk treɪz slaɪd ɔf ði ɑrm./
dialogue.zh: 紙杯能疊，托盤會從手臂滑下去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which ring did you pick first?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ rɪŋ dɪd ju pɪk fɜrst?/
dialogue.zh: 你先拿了哪一個？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The plain one, I trust plain things.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə pleɪn wʌn aɪ trʌst pleɪn θɪŋz./
dialogue.zh: 原味那個，我信得過原味。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine has a hole, so it is honest.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn hæz ə hoʊl soʊ ɪt ɪz ˈɑnɪst./
dialogue.zh: 我手上這個有洞，很誠實。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A hole holds the extra sugar.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə hoʊl hoʊldz ði ˈɛkstrə ˈʃʊɡər./
dialogue.zh: 那個洞會藏多一點的糖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not count them again, I counted.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt kaʊnt ðəm əˈɡɛn aɪ ˈkaʊntɪd./
dialogue.zh: 別再數了，我已經數過。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Counted twice, five left, we ate two.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkaʊntɪd twaɪs, faɪv lɛft, wi et tu./
dialogue.zh: 數兩次都剩五個，我們吃了兩個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five is a good number for tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv ɪz ə ɡʊd ˈnʌmbər fɔr təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 五個對今晚來說剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Greedy, sure, but five rings will do.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɡridi, ʃʊr, bʌt faɪv rɪŋz wɪl du./
dialogue.zh: 貪嘴是肯定的，但五個夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Save one ring for the lobby chair.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪv wʌn rɪŋ fɔr ðə ˈlɑbi tʃɛr./
dialogue.zh: 留一個在大廳的椅子上吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lobby rule says nothing outside a room.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɑbi rul sɛz ˈnʌθɪŋ ˌaʊtˈsaɪd ə rum./
dialogue.zh: 大廳規定寫著，房間以外不能吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then we eat them in the elevator.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi it ðɛm ɪn ði ˈɛləˌveɪtər./
dialogue.zh: 那我們就在電梯裡吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Elevator is a poor dining room.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛləˌveɪtər ɪz ə pʊr ˈdaɪnɪŋ rum./
dialogue.zh: 電梯當餐廳實在太差。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A crumb falls, and someone sees it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə krʌm fɔlz ænd ˈsʌmwʌn siz ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 掉一粒屑，就會有人看見。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clean it yourself, the stalls taught that.
dialogue.phonetic: /klin ɪt jʊrˈsɛlf ðə stɔlz tɔt ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 自己擦掉，那一排攤子教過我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Walk slower, the bag swings too high.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔk ˈsloʊər ðə bæɡ swɪŋz tu haɪ./
dialogue.zh: 走慢一點，袋子晃得太高了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slower works, keep it at your knee.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsloʊər wɜrks kip ɪt æt jʊr ni./
dialogue.zh: 慢走有用，讓它只到大腿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two stalls back, someone wants a ring.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu stɔlz bæk ˈsʌmwʌn wɑnts ə rɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 往後兩個攤子，有人想要一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give the plain one, we have an extra.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɪv ðə pleɪn wʌn wi hæv ən ˈɛkstrə./
dialogue.zh: 把原味那個給他，我們多一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the box holds only four.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə bɑks hoʊldz ˈoʊnli fɔr./
dialogue.zh: 現在盒子裡只剩四個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four rings, and he waves thanks at us.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr rɪŋz, ænd hi weɪvz θæŋks ət ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 四個，他朝我們揮手道謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The next stall sells salty things.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə nɛkst stɔl sɛlz ˈsɔlti θɪŋz./
dialogue.zh: 下一個攤子賣鹹的東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Salty needs sweet, that is why we stopped.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɔlti nidz swit ðæt ɪz waɪ wi stɑpt./
dialogue.zh: 鹹的就需要甜的，這就是停下的理由。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more ring and we are sick.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr rɪŋ ænd wi ɑr sɪk./
dialogue.zh: 再吃一個就要吐了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sick is worth it, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪk ɪz wɜrθ ɪt ˈɑnəstli./
dialogue.zh: 會想吐也值得，說實話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, she waves us to come back.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk ʃi weɪvz ʌs tu kʌm bæk./
dialogue.zh: 看她朝我們揮手，叫我們再回去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Back means a second box, careful.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæk minz ə ˈsɛkənd bɑks ˈkɛrfəl./
dialogue.zh: 再回去就是第二盒，小心點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One box only, that is the deal.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn bɑks ˈoʊnli ðæt ɪz ðə dil./
dialogue.zh: 只買一盒，說定這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deal sealed, carry it and go.
dialogue.phonetic: /dil sild ˈkæri ɪt ænd ɡoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 說定了，提著它走吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bag is warm against my hand.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bæɡ ɪz wɔrm əˈɡɛnst maɪ hænd./
dialogue.zh: 袋子貼著我的手，暖暖的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Warm hands forgive a long walk.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm hændz fərˈɡɪv ə lɔŋ wɔk./
dialogue.zh: 手一暖，回旅館的路就不算長。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four rings, one bag, no more stops.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr rɪŋz, wʌn bæɡ, noʊ mɔr stɑps./
dialogue.zh: 四個甜甜圈，一個袋子，不再停了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No more stops, the hotel is close.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ mɔr stɑps ðə hoʊˈtɛl ɪz kloʊs./
dialogue.zh: 不再停，旅館已經不遠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Walk out with the box and the bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔk aʊt wɪθ ðə bɑks ænd ðə bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 盒子和袋子都提起來，走出去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both are ours, the night market ends.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ ɑr ˈaʊərz ðə naɪt ˈmɑrkɪt ɛndz./
dialogue.zh: 兩樣都是我們的了，夜市要結束了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The market gate is behind us now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈmɑrkɪt ɡeɪt ɪz bɪˈhaɪnd ʌs naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 夜市的大門已經在我們背後了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Behind it, the lamps are going out.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪˈhaɪnd ɪt ðə læmpz ɑr ˈɡoʊɪŋ aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 背後那些紅燈籠，正在一盞盞熄掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we walk or wait for a taxi?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi wɔk ɔr weɪt fɔr ə ˈtæksi?/
dialogue.zh: 我們用走的，還是等計程車？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Walk, the hotel is twelve minutes away.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔk ðə hoʊˈtɛl ɪz twɛlv ˈmɪnɪts əˈweɪ./
dialogue.zh: 走好了，旅館離這裡十二分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twelve minutes with two full bags.
dialogue.phonetic: /twɛlv ˈmɪnɪts wɪθ tu fʊl bæɡz./
dialogue.zh: 提著兩個滿袋子走十二分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we rest at every corner.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi rɛst æt ˈɛvri ˈkɔrnər./
dialogue.zh: 那就在每個路口歇一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which way, this lane looks closed?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ weɪ ðɪs leɪn lʊks kloʊzd?/
dialogue.zh: 往哪邊走？這條巷子看起來封起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Left at the fruit cart, then straight.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛft æt ðə frut kɑrt ðɛn streɪt./
dialogue.zh: 在水果車那裡左轉，然後直走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fruit cart man folded his table.
dialogue.phonetic: /frut kɑrt mæn ˈfoʊldɪd hɪz ˈteɪbəl./
dialogue.zh: 賣水果的車已經把桌子收起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Folded tables mean the market is done.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfoʊldɪd ˈteɪbəlz min ðə ˈmɑrkɪt ɪz dʌn./
dialogue.zh: 桌子一收，就代表夜市散了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oil stains mark where the skewers stood.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔɪl steɪnz mɑrk wɛr ðə ˈskjʊrz stʊd./
dialogue.zh: 地上的油漬，還標著烤串攤的位置。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good thing we carried our own bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd θɪŋ wi ˈkærid ˈaʊr oʊn bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 還好我們自己提了袋子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My bag smells like chili and oil.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ bæɡ smɛlz laɪk ˈtʃɪli ænd ɔɪl./
dialogue.zh: 我的袋子聞起來全是辣椒和辣油。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Chili and oil is our perfume tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtʃɪli ænd ɔɪl ɪz ˈaʊər pərˈfjum təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 今晚我們的香水，就是辣油味。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: People at the crossing stare at us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpipəl æt ðə ˈkrɔsɪŋ stɛr æt ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 路口的人都在盯著我們看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They stare at the box, not you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ stɛr æt ðə bɑks nɑt ju./
dialogue.zh: 他們盯的是盒子，不是你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The walk signal is on, let us cross.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wɔk ˈsɪɡnəl ɪz ɑn lɛt ʌs krɔs./
dialogue.zh: 行人綠燈亮了，我們過馬路。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cross slowly, the box is sliding.
dialogue.phonetic: /krɔs ˈsloʊli ðə bɑks ɪz ˈslaɪdɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 慢點走，盒子一直在往下滑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold the lid, the rings will shift.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ðə lɪd ðə rɪŋz wɪl ʃɪft./
dialogue.zh: 扶住盒蓋，甜甜圈會移位。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I hold it, you watch the cars.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hoʊld ɪt ju wɑtʃ ðə kɑrz./
dialogue.zh: 我扶著，你看車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your paper bag is losing its bottom.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr ˈpeɪpər bæɡ ɪz ˈluzɪŋ ɪts ˈbɑtəm./
dialogue.zh: 你的紙袋底部快掉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lose it and the cake falls out.
dialogue.phonetic: /luz ɪt ænd ðə keɪk fɔlz aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 袋子一掉，油餅就全部灑出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Move the cake into our cloth bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /muv ðə keɪk ˈɪntu ˈaʊər klɔθ bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 把油餅挪進我們的布袋裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cloth bag works, the grease stays in.
dialogue.phonetic: /klɔθ bæɡ wɜrks ðə ɡris steɪz ɪn./
dialogue.zh: 布袋剛好，油都留在裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two blocks left, the street gets quiet.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu blɑks lɛft ðə strit ɡɛts ˈkwaɪət./
dialogue.zh: 還剩兩個街口，路上安靜下來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Quiet streets make the bags feel heavier.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkwaɪət strits meɪk ðə bæɡz fil ˈhɛviər./
dialogue.zh: 路面一安靜，袋子就感覺更重了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not swing the doughnut box.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt swɪŋ ðə ˈdoʊnət bɑks./
dialogue.zh: 別甩那個甜甜圈盒子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I swing it, the sugar stays put.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ swɪŋ ɪt ðə ˈʃʊɡər steɪz pʊt./
dialogue.zh: 我晃了一下，糖粉還是穩穩的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the temple gate lights are off.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk ðə ˈtɛmpəl ɡeɪt laɪts ɑr ɔf./
dialogue.zh: 你看，廟口的燈全關了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Off since nine, the bank machine works.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔf sɪns naɪn ðə bæŋk məˈʃin wɜrks./
dialogue.zh: 九點就關了，提款機還在運轉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No cash needed, we already paid.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ kæʃ ˈnidɪd wi ɔlˈrɛdi peɪd./
dialogue.zh: 不需要現金了，我們都付清了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Paid in full, our wallet sleeps tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /peɪd ɪn fʊl ˈaʊər ˈwɑlɪt slips təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 付清了，錢包今晚可以休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more turn, then our hotel sign.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr tɜrn ðɛn ˈaʊər hoʊˈtɛl saɪn./
dialogue.zh: 再轉一次，就能看到旅館的招牌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blue sign, small letters, hard to find.
dialogue.phonetic: /blu saɪn smɔl ˈlɛtərz hɑrd tu faɪnd./
dialogue.zh: 藍色招牌，字很小，很難找。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our lobby door feels heavy again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər ˈlɑbi dɔr filz ˈhɛvi əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 我們大廳的門又變得很重。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Heavy doors want a free hand.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɛvi dɔrz wɑnt ə fri hænd./
dialogue.zh: 很重的門，需要空出來的那隻手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Kick the door, your hands are full.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɪk ðə dɔr jʊr hændz ɑr fʊl./
dialogue.zh: 用腳踢一下門吧，你兩手滿的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Kicking hurts, the clerk will open it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɪkɪŋ hɜrts ðə klɜrk wɪl ˈoʊpən ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 踢了會痛，櫃台人員會幫你開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He sees the bags and smiles.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi siz ðə bæɡz ænd smaɪlz./
dialogue.zh: 他一看見袋子就笑了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smiles, then points at our late hour.
dialogue.phonetic: /smaɪlz ðɛn pɔɪnts æt ˈaʊr leɪt ˈaʊər./
dialogue.zh: 笑完，又指指我們這麼晚回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fourth floor, and the elevator is broken.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔrθ flɔr, ænd ði ˈɛləˌveɪtər ɪz ˈbroʊkən./
dialogue.zh: 四樓，可是電梯壞掉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Broken means stairs with two bags.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbroʊkən minz stɛrz wɪθ tu bæɡz./
dialogue.zh: 壞掉就代表要提兩個袋子上樓梯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take the box, I take the cake.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ðə bɑks, aɪ teɪk ðə keɪk./
dialogue.zh: 你拿盒子，我拿那包油餅。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Box upstairs, the cake waits on the desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɑks ˌʌpˈstɛrz, ðə keɪk weɪts ɑn ðə dɛsk./
dialogue.zh: 盒子帶上樓，油餅擱在書桌上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We rest twice, my legs are done.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi rɛst twaɪs, maɪ lɛɡz ər dʌn./
dialogue.zh: 我們歇了兩次，我的腿沒力了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twice is fair for two full bags.
dialogue.phonetic: /twaɪs ɪz fɛr fɔr tu fʊl bæɡz./
dialogue.zh: 提兩個滿袋子，停兩次很公道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Key card, tap it, then the light turns green.
dialogue.phonetic: /ki kɑrd tæp ɪt ðɛn ðə laɪt tɜrnz ɡrin./
dialogue.zh: 房卡貼一下，燈轉綠就可以了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Green means the lock will listen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡrin minz ðə lɑk wɪl ˈlɪsən./
dialogue.zh: 變綠，代表讀卡機願意聽話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our room smells like cleaner, not food.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər rum smɛlz laɪk ˈklinər nɑt fud./
dialogue.zh: 房間聞起來只有清潔劑，沒有食物味。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cleaner smell, then our chili smell.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈklinər smɛl ðɛn ˈaʊər ˈtʃɪli smɛl./
dialogue.zh: 清潔劑味先來，辣味隨後就到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shoes off, the carpet takes grease.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃuz ɔf ðə ˈkɑrpɪt teɪks ɡris./
dialogue.zh: 先脫鞋，地毯會沾油。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Grease on carpet costs a fee.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡris ɑn ˈkɑrpɪt kɔsts ə fi./
dialogue.zh: 地毯沾了油，是要賠錢的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put the box on the small desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt ðə bɑks ɑn ðə smɔl dɛsk./
dialogue.zh: 把盒子放在小書桌上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Desk is better, the bed is too soft.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɛsk ɪz ˈbɛtər ðə bɛd ɪz tu sɔft./
dialogue.zh: 書桌比較穩，床太軟了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One ring fell onto the floor mat.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn rɪŋ fɛl ˈɑntu ðə flɔr mæt./
dialogue.zh: 有一個掉在門口的地墊上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Floor mat ring goes to the bin.
dialogue.phonetic: /flɔr mæt rɪŋ ɡoʊz tu ðə bɪn./
dialogue.zh: 掉在地墊上的那個，就丟進垃圾桶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three rings left, we counted them.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri rɪŋz lɛft, wi ˈkaʊntɪd ðɛm./
dialogue.zh: 剩下三個，我們數過了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Counted three, so share them evenly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkaʊntɪd θri, soʊ ʃɛr ðɛm ˈivənli./
dialogue.zh: 數過是三個，那就平均分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Even means one each and one odd.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈivən minz wʌn itʃ, ænd wʌn ɑd./
dialogue.zh: 平均分就是各一個，多出一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Odd one goes to whoever washed hands.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑd wʌn ɡoʊz tu huˈɛvər wɑʃt hændz./
dialogue.zh: 多出來那個，歸剛洗過手的人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I washed, so I get the extra.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɑʃt soʊ aɪ ɡɛt ði ˈɛkstrə./
dialogue.zh: 我洗過手，所以多那個是我的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fair rule, wipe your face first.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛr rul waɪp jʊr feɪs fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 規倒是公道，不過先把你臉上的糖擦掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The cake bag left a grease mark here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə keɪk bæɡ lɛft ə ɡris mɑrk hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 裝油餅的袋子在桌上留了油印。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A grease mark, the desk saw worse.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ɡris mɑrk ðə dɛsk sɔ wɜrs./
dialogue.zh: 不過是油印，這張桌子見過更壞的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Clean it with a folded towel.
dialogue.phonetic: /klin ɪt wɪθ ə ˈfoʊldɪd ˈtaʊəl./
dialogue.zh: 用一條摺好的毛巾擦一擦。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Towels stay white here, use the napkin.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtaʊəlz steɪ waɪt hɪr juz ðə ˈnæpkɪn./
dialogue.zh: 旅館毛巾要保持乾淨，改用紙巾吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Napkin wipe, then the box again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnæpkɪn waɪp ðɛn ðə bɑks əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 用紙巾擦完，再回頭處理盒子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Box again, lids closed, lights low.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɑks əˈɡɛn lɪdz kloʊzd laɪts loʊ./
dialogue.zh: 盒子收好，蓋子蓋緊，燈調暗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we save the leftover rings?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi seɪv ðə ˈlɛftoʊvər rɪŋz?/
dialogue.zh: 吃剩下的，要留到明天嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Save them under the desk lamp.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪv ðɛm ˈʌndər ðə dɛsk læmp./
dialogue.zh: 先放在書桌燈下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A lamp is not a fridge.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə læmp ɪz nɑt ə frɪdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 台燈又不是冰箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No fridge, so eat them by morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ frɪdʒ soʊ it ðɛm baɪ ˈmɔrnɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 沒有冰箱，那就天亮之前吃完。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: By morning, sugar on the pillow.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ˈmɔrnɪŋ ˈʃʊɡər ɑn ðə ˈpɪloʊ./
dialogue.zh: 到了早上，枕頭上會有糖粉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pillow sugar is a night market gift.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɪloʊ ˈʃʊɡər ɪz ə naɪt ˈmɑrkɪt ɡɪft./
dialogue.zh: 枕頭上的糖粉，是夜市送的禮物。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Brush the crumbs off the blanket.
dialogue.phonetic: /brʌʃ ðə krʌmz ɔf ðə ˈblæŋkɪt./
dialogue.zh: 把毛毯上的屑刷掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Crumbs brushed, now brush your teeth.
dialogue.phonetic: /krʌmz brʌʃt naʊ brʌʃ jʊr tiθ./
dialogue.zh: 屑刷完了，現在去刷牙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Teeth first, the bag still waits.
dialogue.phonetic: /tiθ fɜrst ðə bæɡ stɪl weɪts./
dialogue.zh: 先去刷牙，袋子還在等。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bags can wait beside the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæɡz kən weɪt bɪˈsaɪd ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 袋子等得起，放在門邊就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tomorrow the alley stalls start at six.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈmɑroʊ ði ˈæli stɔlz stɑrt æt sɪks./
dialogue.zh: 明天巷子的攤子六點就開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six is early after this much walking.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ɪz ˈɜrli ˈæftər ðɪs mʌtʃ ˈwɔkɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 走了這麼多路，六點太早了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Set two alarms, one for the cart.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛt tu əˈlɑrmz wʌn fɔr ðə kɑrt./
dialogue.zh: 設兩個鬧鐘，一個留給推車攤。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cart alarm, you mean the tea stall.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑrt əˈlɑrm ju min ðə ti stɔl./
dialogue.zh: 推車攤的鬧鐘，你講的其實是茶水攤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tea stall closes for one hour.
dialogue.phonetic: /ti stɔl ˈkloʊzɪz fɔr wʌn ˈaʊər./
dialogue.zh: 茶水攤只關一個小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One hour, so we wake before it.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈaʊər soʊ wi weɪk bɪˈfɔr ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 那一小時結束之前，我們就得醒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sleep now, the trash sits in the bin.
dialogue.phonetic: /slip naʊ, ðə træʃ sɪts ɪn ðə bɪn./
dialogue.zh: 睡了，垃圾都進桶子了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bin closed, the room is ours again.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪn kloʊzd ðə rum ɪz ˈaʊərz əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 桶蓋關了，房間又是我們的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My shirt still carries the grill smoke.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ʃɜrt stɪl ˈkæriz ðə ɡrɪl smoʊk./
dialogue.zh: 我的襯衫還留著烤肉的煙味。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hang it by the window, not inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæŋ ɪt baɪ ðə ˈwɪndoʊ nɑt ɪnˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 掛到窗邊，不要掛在屋裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Window is stuck, the latch is bent.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɪndoʊ ɪz stʌk ðə lætʃ ɪz bɛnt./
dialogue.zh: 窗戶卡住了，鎖扣是彎的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bent latch, clerk fixes it in the morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɛnt lætʃ klɜrk ˈfɪksɪz ɪt ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 鎖扣彎了，早上請櫃台來修。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: In the morning we ask for soap.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ wi æsk fɔr soʊp./
dialogue.zh: 早上先要一塊肥皂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soap, hot water, and a clean cloth.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊp hɑt ˈwɔtər ænd ə klin klɔθ./
dialogue.zh: 肥皂、熱水，還有一塊乾淨的布。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One cloth, then we go again.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn klɔθ ðɛn wi ɡoʊ əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 洗一塊布，然後我們再出去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Again means back to the same corner.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈɡɛn minz bæk tu ðə seɪm ˈkɔrnər./
dialogue.zh: 再出去，就是回到同一個路口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same corner, same red lanterns, maybe.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm ˈkɔrnər seɪm rɛd ˈlæntərnz ˈmeɪbi./
dialogue.zh: 同樣的路口，同樣的紅燈籠，說不準。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe not, stalls move every night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi nɑt stɔlz muv ˈɛvri naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 說不準，攤子每晚都會換位置。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then tomorrow we ask where they moved.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn təˈmɑroʊ wi æsk wɛr ðeɪ muvd./
dialogue.zh: 那明天就問他們搬到哪裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask the auntie, she knows the map.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk ðə ˈænti ʃi noʊz ðə mæp./
dialogue.zh: 去問那位阿嬤，她腦中有整張地圖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bag by the door, box on the desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæɡ baɪ ðə dɔr bɑks ɑn ðə dɛsk./
dialogue.zh: 袋子放門邊，盒子放桌上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everything placed, good night, night market.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ pleɪst ɡʊd naɪt naɪt ˈmɑrkɪt./
dialogue.zh: 都歸位了，晚安，夜市。
